summary_en.technical_approach: The paper argues that existing model-editing methods use a single global correction subspace for all test samples, which cannot capture diverse hallucination modes. It proposes per-instance disentangled subspaces for finer-grained representation correction without updating model weights. The provided abstract is truncated, so the exact subspace construction and inference procedure are not fully specified.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report the LVLMs used, hallucination benchmarks, baselines, inference overhead, or quantitative results.

paper.title: TruthLens: Object Hallucination Detection via Self-Evaluating Truthfulness Scores in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable progress of large vision language models (LVLMs), object hallucination remains a fundamental challenge that hinders their trustworthy deployment. A key finding motivates our work: real and hallucinated object tokens are clearly separable in hidden representations, yet this separability is largely lost at the language-modeling (LM) head. We propose TruthLens, a self-evaluation framework that teaches the LM head to expose a per-object truthfulness signal without any auxiliar

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决 LVLM 的物体幻觉检测问题，重点不是再训练一个外部 verifier，而是让模型自己的 LM head 暴露每个物体 token 的真实性信号。核心观察是：真实物体 token 和幻觉物体 token 在隐藏状态里可分，但经过 LM head 映射到词表概率后，这种可分性明显减弱。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于模型内部表征和输出头之间的信号损失。隐藏层已经编码了一部分真实性或不确定性信息，但常规 next-token 目标没有要求 LM head 把这类信息显式输出。TruthLens 用一个特殊 token 承接 token-level truthfulness score，提供了一种轻量的自评估接口。它和 verifier、reward model、self-confidence calibration、LVLM 幻觉抑制都有关系，也提示预训练或后训练阶段可以加入更结构化的“可读出置信信号”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分两步。第一步是诊断：用 token-level negative log-likelihood 观察 LM head 的预测置信度，用 LDA 在线性空间中测量隐藏状态对真实/幻觉物体 token 的可分性。结果显示隐藏特征更可分，输出概率更含混。第二步是训练 TruthLens：选择一个很少使用的特殊 token 作为 reference token。在每个物体 token 的预测位置，读取 LM head 分配给该特殊 token 的 log-probability，并减去一个预设常数，得到 truthfulness score。训练时，对每张图采样多条 caption，标注其中物体 token 是真实还是幻觉；用 MSE 把真实 token 的分数推向 1，把幻觉 token 的分数推向 0。同时加入 divergence constraint，限制新模型偏离原始生成分布，避免检测能力提升伴随生成能力退化。推理时只读取已有 LM head 的概率，不需要额外模型，也不增加额外前向计算。
summary.experiments: 论文在多个 LVLM 和多个物体幻觉检测基准上评估，报告相对已有 OH detection 方法有稳定提升。一个重要结果是训练标注只覆盖有限物体类别，但方法能迁移到标签空间更大的 benchmark，说明它学到的不只是类别记忆，而是某种 token-level groundedness 信号。全文片段没有给出具体数值、模型列表和各 benchmark 指标，因此定量幅度需要以实验表格为准。值得关注的消融包括：特殊 token 选择、预设常数和阈值 μ、MSE 监督、divergence constraint、不同层隐藏状态可分性，以及跨模型泛化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Fig. 3，确认 hidden representation separability 和 LM-head ambiguity 的证据是否充分。然后看方法部分的 truthfulness score 定义，特别是为什么用特殊 token 的 log-probability，而不是直接训练一个 probe 或外部 classifier。实验部分优先看跨 LVLM、跨 benchmark、跨类别空间的泛化结果，再看 divergence constraint 是否保护原有生成质量。对预训练研究更有用的是“把隐藏层中的真实性信号接到 LM head 输出空间”这个接口设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses object hallucination detection in LVLMs without relying on an external verifier. Its central observation is that real and hallucinated object tokens are separable in hidden representations, but this separability is largely weakened after the LM head maps them into vocabulary probabilities.
summary_en.importance: The work is useful for studying the gap between internal representations and exposed model outputs. LVLM hidden states already encode some truthfulness or uncertainty signal, but standard next-token training does not force the LM head to make that signal readable. TruthLens uses a special token as a token-level truthfulness channel. This connects to verifier design, reward modeling, self-confidence calibration, and hallucination control. It also suggests that pretraining or post-training objectives can include structured readout signals instead of relying only on free-form generation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method starts with a diagnostic comparison. Token-level negative log-likelihood is used to inspect LM-head confidence, while LDA is applied to hidden states to measure separability between real and hallucinated object tokens. The finding is that hidden states are more discriminative than output distributions. TruthLens then repurposes a rarely used special token as a reference token. At the prediction position of each object token, the method reads the log-probability assigned to this special token by the LM head and subtracts a predefined constant to obtain a truthfulness score. During training, multiple captions are sampled for each image, object tokens are labeled as real or hallucinated, and an MSE loss pushes real-token scores toward 1 and hallucinated-token scores toward 0. A divergence constraint keeps the updated model close to the original generation behavior. At inference time, the score is read from the existing LM head distribution, so no auxiliary model or extra forward pass is required.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates the method across multiple LVLMs and object hallucination benchmarks, reporting consistent gains over existing detection approaches. A notable result is that the training annotations cover only a limited set of object categories, yet the learned signal transfers to benchmarks with much larger label spaces. This suggests the method is not merely memorizing category labels, but learning a token-level groundedness readout. The supplied content does not provide exact numbers, model names, or metric tables, so the magnitude of the gains should be verified in the experimental section. Important ablations include the choice of special token, the predefined constant and threshold μ, the MSE supervision, the divergence constraint, layer-wise hidden-state separability, and cross-model generalization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with Fig. 3 to check the evidence for hidden-state separability and LM-head ambiguity. Then read the truthfulness-score definition and focus on why the authors use the log-probability of a special token instead of a learned probe or external classifier. In the experiments, prioritize cross-LVLM, cross-benchmark, and cross-category generalization, then check whether the divergence constraint preserves normal generation quality. For pretraining researchers, the transferable idea is the LM-head readout interface for internal truthfulness signals.

recommendation.zh: 把'LM head丢失可分性'做成可训练探针的思路值得VLM对齐者借鉴；看§3方法和探针可视化即可，数字别太当真。
recommendation.en: The idea of training the LM head to surface a separability signal is a neat trick for VLM alignment; read §3 and the probe visualizations, treat headline numbers cautiously.

paper.title: Aligning Large Vision-Language Models at Test Time: A Trajectory-Guided Structured Sampling Approach
paper.abstract: Post-training reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms are commonly used to align large vision-language models (LVLMs) with human intent and the requirements of visual reasoning tasks. However, existing RL-based alignment methods are often resource-intensive and encounter mismatches between training objectives and inference-time distributions. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel test-time alignment approach that leverages trajectory-guided structured sampling for dynamic inference-time refineme

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 后训练对齐成本高、训练目标与推理时分布不匹配的问题，尝试在测试时动态修正视觉推理轨迹。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态推理的 test-time alignment 方法，不需要重新进行 RL 后训练；对预训练研究的价值主要在于观察推理时结构先验如何替代部分训练时对齐信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先通过 trajectory learning 构建 reasoning memory bank，把复杂视觉问答分解为预定义推理模式序列；推理时从 memory bank 采样轨迹形成全局结构先验，再用迭代 MCMC 式结构化采样做动态 refinement，以改善视觉 grounding 和逻辑一致性。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该方法在视觉 grounding 和逻辑一致性上优于常规 RL-based alignment 或直接推理方式，但给定信息未包含具体 LVLM backbone、模型参数量、benchmark 名称、提升幅度和推理成本。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 East China Normal University、Hasso Plattner Institute、University of Potsdam 和 City University of Hong Kong。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost and train-test mismatch of LVLM alignment by dynamically refining visual reasoning trajectories at test time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a test-time alignment method for multimodal reasoning, avoiding additional RL post-training. Its pretraining relevance is indirect: it probes how inference-time structural priors can substitute for some training-time alignment signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first builds a reasoning memory bank through trajectory learning, decomposing complex visual QA into ordered sequences of predefined reasoning patterns. At inference time, it samples trajectories from the bank to form a global structural prior, then applies iterative MCMC-style structured sampling for refinement to improve grounding and consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims improvements in visual grounding and logical consistency over RL-based alignment or direct inference baselines, but the provided text does not specify LVLM backbones, parameter counts, benchmarks, effect sizes, or added inference cost.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with East China Normal University, Hasso Plattner Institute, University of Potsdam, and City University of Hong Kong.

recommendation.zh: 推理时对齐的想法可备查；重点看 MCMC 采样开销和 memory bank 构造，缺成本曲线就别信泛化收益。
recommendation.en: Worth noting as test-time alignment; inspect the MCMC cost and memory-bank construction, and distrust generalization claims without a cost curve.

paper.title: Can LVLMs Uncover the Truth Behind Visual Illusions? An Analysis of Perceptual and Reasoning Capabilities
paper.abstract: Large Vision Language Models have integrated reasoning capabilities, elevating cognitive performance to new levels. However, existing evaluations either focus solely on perception or rely on specific domains such as maths or coding. Evaluation for reasoning capabilities that align with an open-world environment is still required, especially one that considers perception and reasoning jointly. To bridge this gap, we propose to evaluate LVLMs by exploiting visual illusions as a diagnostic tool. Vi

summary.core_problem: 用视觉错觉作为诊断工具，评估 LVLM 是否能同时处理视觉感知误导和后续推理，而不是只在常规感知、数学或代码任务上表现良好。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 评测资产与诊断分析。价值在于把感知失败和推理失败放到同一个开放式场景里拆开看，可帮助判断多模态预训练是否真的学到稳定的视觉表征和跨模态推理接口。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 IllusionReasoning benchmark，收集真实世界视觉错觉图像，并配套多样化的标注问答。评测设计利用错觉图像中“客观信号”和“人类直觉误读”的差异，观察 LVLM 是被视觉表象带偏，还是能通过语言推理恢复客观判断。
summary.experiments: 摘要称评测覆盖一系列 LVLM，并发现它们的推理能力弱于常见宣传口径。公开摘要未给出具体模型清单、样本规模、准确率或分项提升数字，因此需要读实验表确认失败类型、模型代际差异和 judge 设置是否干净。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Adelaide University、State Key Laboratory of AI Safety、Institute of Computing Technology、University of Chinese Academy of Sciences、Tsinghua University、Amap、Alibaba Group、Beihang University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses visual illusions to test whether LVLMs can jointly handle misleading perception and downstream reasoning, rather than only scoring well on standard perception, math, or coding evaluations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a VLM evaluation asset and diagnostic study. Its value is in coupling perceptual failure with reasoning failure, which is useful for understanding whether multimodal pretraining learns robust visual representations and a reliable vision-language reasoning interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build IllusionReasoning, a benchmark of real-world illusion images with diverse annotated QA pairs. The evaluation exploits the gap between objective visual signals and illusion-induced interpretations to see whether LVLMs follow the misleading percept or recover the correct answer through reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation across a broad set of LVLMs and finds that their reasoning ability is weaker than commonly claimed. The provided abstract does not include model lists, dataset size, exact accuracy, or ablation numbers, so the experimental tables are needed to assess failure taxonomy and judge reliability.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Adelaide University, State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, Institute of Computing Technology, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University, Amap, Alibaba Group, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和失败分解即可；若错觉样本没有泄漏和标注偏差，它能暴露 VLM 预训练里视觉表征的脆点。
recommendation.en: Read the dataset construction and failure breakdown; if leakage and annotation bias are controlled, it is a useful probe of brittle visual representations in VLM pretraining.

paper.title: Be Consistent! Enhancing Robust Visual Reasoning in LVLMs with Consistency Constraints
paper.abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit strong perceptual capabilities, they remain vulnerable in visual reasoning tasks. Existing benchmarks largely focus on symbolic mathematical or scientific problems and simple vision-centric tasks, offering limited assessment of complex visual reasoning and logical consistency, a critical requirement for reliable reasoning systems. We introduce ConVBench, a complex vision-centric reasoning benchmark in which each image is paired with two logicall

summary.core_problem: 评估并改进 LVLM 在复杂视觉推理中的逻辑一致性：模型可能答对单个问题，但对逻辑等价问题给出不一致答案。

summary.technical_approach: 提出 ConVBench，每张图像配对两个逻辑等价问题，覆盖动作与状态、复杂计数、空间推理、因果与意图、常识推理、时间感知六类。评测上定义 logical consistency 和 robust accuracy；方法上提出 ConVLM，用 GRPO 强化学习把一致性约束纳入 LVLM 训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates and improves logical consistency in LVLM visual reasoning, where a model may answer one question correctly but fail on a logically equivalent counterpart.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a vision-centric reasoning benchmark, consistency-aware metrics, and a GRPO-based training method. It is not pretraining work, but it is relevant to multimodal post-training signal design and evaluation protocol design.
summary_en.technical_approach: ConVBench pairs each image with two logically equivalent questions across six categories: action/state, complex counting, spatial reasoning, causal and intent understanding, commonsense reasoning, and temporal perception. The paper defines logical consistency and robust accuracy, and introduces ConVLM, which applies GRPO with consistency constraints.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, data scale, baselines, or exact gains. The experiments likely compare LVLMs on correctness, consistency, and robust accuracy, and measure the effect of GRPO-based consistency training.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of Texas at Dallas and Amazon Web Services.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 构造和 robust accuracy 定义；GRPO 部分更像后训练套件，别过度外推到基座训练。
recommendation.en: Read the benchmark construction and robust-accuracy metric; the GRPO part is a post-training recipe and should not be over-generalized to base training.

paper.title: Look Clearly Before Answering: Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs via Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal understanding. However, they remain prone to hallucinations, generating responses that are inconsistent with the visual evidence. Existing mitigation methods largely address language-prior bias or cross-modal imbalance, while progressive visual degradation across perception and memory remains underexplored. In this work, we propose Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment (SDPR), a training-free framework

summary.core_problem: 缓解 LVLM 在回答过程中逐步丢失视觉证据、进而产生与图像不一致的幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练免费推理修正和机制观察。它把 LVLM 幻觉的一部分原因定位到 attention sink 和 KV cache 的视觉空间失真，而不只归因于语言先验或跨模态权重失衡。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment。第一步用 saliency-driven attention redistribution 释放被非语义 sink token 占用的注意力；第二步做 saliency-driven cache alignment，减少生成过程中 KV cache 对查询相关视觉特征的空间扭曲；第三步用 prior-constrained contrastive decoding 惩罚不忠实的候选输出。方法是推理期插件，不需要重新训练 LVLM。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LVLM、benchmark、baseline 和提升数值。可确认的实验目标是视觉幻觉缓解，比较对象应包括已有训练免费解码或注意力修正方法，但数值需要查正文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce LVLM hallucinations caused by progressive loss of visual evidence during generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference correction method plus a mechanistic observation. It attributes part of LVLM hallucination to attention sinks and spatial distortion in the KV cache, not only to language priors or cross-modal imbalance.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Saliency-Driven Perceptual Realignment has three components: saliency-driven attention redistribution to recover attention hijacked by non-semantic sink tokens, saliency-driven cache alignment to preserve query-relevant visual features during decoding, and prior-constrained contrastive decoding to penalize visually unfaithful candidates. It is an inference-time plug-in rather than a retraining recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific LVLMs, benchmarks, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluated target is visual hallucination mitigation, likely against existing training-free decoding or attention-adjustment methods, but the actual numbers require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attention sink 与 KV cache distortion 的证据图；方法像插件，结论可当 VLM 推理机制弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the evidence on attention sinks and KV-cache distortion; the method is a plug-in, but the mechanism claim is a useful weak signal for VLM inference.

paper.title: SAB-LVLM: Significance-Aware Binarization for Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in multimodal understanding, yet their enormous parameter scale and cross-modal computation incur substantial memory and latency overhead, severely limiting real-world deployment on resource-constrained devices. Binarization offers an attractive solution by drastically reducing storage and computational costs. However, existing binarization methods neglect the varying importance of weights across different layers and modaliti

summary.core_problem: 降低大型视觉语言模型在存储、显存和推理延迟上的开销，同时尽量减少二值化带来的性能损失。
summary.importance: 这是 LVLM 压缩与高效部署论文，贡献在于把权重重要性按层和模态区分处理；对预训练本身不是直接推进，但对多模态模型的部署约束和模态敏感参数分析有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAB-LVLM，即 significance-aware binarization。方法基于文本和视觉输入构造 Hessian 矩阵，估计不同层、不同模态权重对任务输出的影响，再据此决定哪些权重需要更谨慎地优化或保留，以缓解统一二值化导致的关键模态权重损伤。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LVLM backbone、参数规模、数据集、baseline 或提升数值；实验目标是相对已有二值化方法降低存储和计算成本，同时保持多模态理解性能。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces memory, storage, and latency costs of large vision-language models while limiting the accuracy loss caused by binarization.
summary_en.importance: This is an LVLM compression and deployment paper. Its contribution is treating weight importance as layer- and modality-dependent; it does not directly advance pretraining, but it is relevant to multimodal model deployment and modality-sensitive parameter analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAB-LVLM introduces significance-aware binarization. It constructs Hessian matrices from textual and visual inputs to estimate the importance of weights across layers and modalities, then uses this signal to avoid damaging modality-critical parameters during binarization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the LVLM backbones, model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against existing binarization methods in the storage-compute versus multimodal-understanding trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 作为 LVLM 二值化备查即可；真正可看的点是 Hessian 重要性是否揭示了模态层间脆弱性。
recommendation.en: Keep it as an LVLM binarization reference; the only interesting signal is whether Hessian importance exposes modality-layer fragility.

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）在长程解码时存在视觉遗忘，注意力逐渐偏离视觉证据，现有方法仅关注后期注意力衰减，忽略早期衰减和视觉sink token问题。

summary.technical_approach: 提出LASER后训练框架，引入两个互补奖励：视觉Grounding奖励鼓励注意力保持在语义显著视觉区域，Sink抑制奖励减少注意力集中在无关视觉token，调节注意力轨迹和视觉token内部分布。

summary.authors_note: 昆士兰大学等机构，无知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: LVLMs suffer from visual forgetting during long-horizon decoding where attention drifts away from visual evidence; existing methods only focus on late-stage attention decay, ignoring early-stage decay and visual sink tokens.
summary_en.importance: Mechanism analysis + post-training method innovation, first identifying early-stage attention decay and task-irrelevant visual sink tokens as key drivers of visual forgetting.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the LASER post-training framework with two complementary rewards: a Visual Grounding Reward to keep attention on semantically salient visual regions, and a Sink Suppression Reward to reduce concentration on irrelevant visual tokens, regulating attention trajectories and intra-visual token distributions.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple mainstream LVLMs, showing stable improvements in long-horizon visual reasoning tasks and more reasonable attention distributions.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliated with The University of Queensland; no notable authors.

paper.title: On Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling is a paradigm where large models use additional compute at inference to achieve better performance, without changing model weights. While it has been widely studied for Large Language Models (LLMs), its applicability to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remains less explored and analyzed, with limited analysis of whether, when, and to what extent these approaches transfer to LVLMs. In this work, we ask a simple but fundamental question: can conventional test-time scaling met

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作回答的是一个很基础但此前并不清楚的问题：LLM 里常见的 test-time scaling 方法，能不能直接迁移到 LVLM，而不是专门为视觉设计一套新技巧。作者进一步把问题拆成三层：哪些方法能迁移、哪些模型规模最受益、哪些任务会受害。全文结论很明确：能迁移，而且小型但能力尚可的 LVLM 受益最大；但在偏感知、低推理需求任务上，额外推理过程反而会把模型带偏。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究不是直接方法贡献，而是对模型能力分布和推理激活机制的实证刻画。价值主要有两点。第一，它提醒人不要把“需要更强 reasoning”与“需要更大模型”简单画等号；在视觉语言场景里，推理能力的一部分已经存在于 instruction-tuned 模型中，额外计算可以把它调出来。第二，它揭示了 LVLM 的一个结构性限制：视觉信息主要在生成早期被吸收，后续长链推理更多依赖已压缩进 hidden state 的表征，因此过长思维链容易脱离图像、转向语言先验和幻觉。这对多模态预训练、视觉 token 压缩、以及后训练中的 reasoning data 设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上这不是提出新 TTS 算法，而是做系统性评估与机制分析。作者聚焦 zero-shot / no-extra-training 的 test-time scaling 范式，也就是不再做额外 SFT 或 RL，而是在现有 instruction-tuned LVLM 上直接使用 LLM 社区常见的推理增强手段。评测覆盖多个模型、多个尺寸、九种 TTS 方法、六个 benchmark。文中还专门拿为 VLM 设计的方法如 Compositional CoT 做对比，检验“通用 LLM 技巧是否已经足够”。

更有意思的是分析部分。作者不是只看最终准确率，而是从 token budget、reasoning chain 质量、attention 行为三个层面解释结果。其核心观察是：LVLM 在生成初期有一个较短的视觉吸收窗口，模型会较强地 attend 到图像，把视觉证据写入 hidden state；之后随着文本继续生成，对图像的注意力逐步衰减，后续 token 更多是在已有内部表征上做语言推演。这样一来，适量推理能帮助复杂任务，但过长推理会让模型在脱离视觉锚点后“越想越偏”。这也是为什么同样的 TTS，在 reasoning-heavy benchmark 上有效，在 perception-heavy benchmark 上却可能掉点。
summary.experiments:
实验规模比较完整：多种 LVLM、不同参数规模、九种 test-time scaling 方法、六个 benchmark。主结果有几个明确结论。第一，传统 LLM TTS 方法可以直接迁移到 LVLM，并且效果通常好于专门为 VLM 设计的某些方法。第二，小模型不是天然不适合 TTS；相反，像 Qwen3-VL-4B 这类小而强的模型，在加入 TTS 后可获得最高约 40% 的相对提升，接近甚至超过未使用 TTS 的更大模型基线，例如文中提到可逼近或超过 Qwen3-VL-32B baseline。第三，TTS 对感知型任务可能有负作用，原因不是算力浪费这么简单，而是 overthinking 导致错误假设累积和 hallucination。

作者还做了 reasoning chain 质量分析，结合 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工评估，检查生成链条在全局和细粒度上的信息充分性。再配合 attention 分析，论文给出的解释链比较完整：性能变化不是偶然，而与视觉证据在生成过程中的衰减机制相关。若从研究角度看，这比单纯 leaderboard 更有价值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，先建立三个结论：小模型受益更大、感知任务会掉点、通用 LLM TTS 方法能迁移。然后看方法部分里九种 TTS 方法的定义和实验设置，确认作者比较的是同一预算下的公平结果。接着重点看 attention analysis 和 token budget 分析，这两部分解释了为什么 LVLM 会 overthink。最后再看 reasoning chain 的 judge/human evaluation，判断作者对“链条质量”的论证是否站得住。预计 35-45 分钟能完成一次高质量泛读。如果只挑最有启发的内容，优先看 Figure 1、主结果表、attention 曲线，以及讨论视觉注意力衰减的段落。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but important question: can standard test-time scaling methods from the LLM literature be transferred directly to large vision-language models, rather than requiring VLM-specific reasoning tricks? It further breaks this into three practical questions: which methods transfer, which model scales benefit most, and on which task types extra inference compute becomes harmful. The central answer is yes, they transfer well; small but capable LVLMs benefit the most; and perceptual tasks can degrade when the model is pushed to reason too much.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining method, but it is useful for understanding capability allocation in multimodal models. Two points matter for foundation-model research. First, it argues against the simple view that stronger reasoning in VLMs must come from larger parameter count or additional post-training. Some reasoning capacity is already latent in instruction-tuned LVLMs and can be activated at inference time. Second, it identifies a structural limitation: visual evidence is consumed early in generation, after which long reasoning chains rely increasingly on an internal compressed representation rather than fresh image grounding. That has implications for multimodal pretraining, visual token compression, and the design of reasoning-oriented post-training data.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is a broad empirical study plus mechanism analysis rather than a new TTS algorithm. The focus is on zero-shot or no-extra-training test-time scaling: prompting, sampling, aggregation, and iterative refinement methods are applied directly to existing instruction-tuned LVLMs, without additional SFT or RL. The study spans multiple model families and sizes, nine TTS methods, and six benchmarks. It also compares against methods designed specifically for VLM reasoning, such as Compositional CoT, to test whether generic LLM techniques are already sufficient.

The stronger part of the paper is the analysis. Instead of reporting only accuracy, the authors examine token budgets, reasoning-chain quality, and attention behavior. Their main observation is that LVLMs have a short early window in which generated tokens attend strongly to the image and absorb visual evidence into the hidden state. After that, attention to the image decays, and later tokens operate more on the internal representation than on direct visual grounding. This explains the mixed effect of test-time scaling: moderate extra reasoning helps on tasks that genuinely require multi-step inference, but excessive reasoning can detach the model from the image and amplify language-prior-driven errors and hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is fairly extensive: multiple LVLMs, multiple parameter scales, nine test-time scaling methods, and six benchmarks. Several findings stand out. First, conventional LLM-style TTS methods transfer well to LVLMs and often outperform some approaches designed specifically for VLMs. Second, small models are not inherently bad at TTS. On the contrary, small but competent models such as Qwen3-VL-4B can gain the most, with improvements reported up to about 40%, reaching or even surpassing the baseline performance of a larger model without TTS, such as Qwen3-VL-32B in some settings. Third, TTS can hurt perceptual tasks, not merely because of wasted compute, but because overthinking introduces wrong assumptions and accumulates hallucinations.

The paper also evaluates reasoning-chain quality using both LLM-as-a-judge and human assessment, at global and fine-grained levels. Combined with the attention analysis, this gives a coherent explanation of when and why TTS helps or hurts. For research readers, that mechanism-level evidence is more useful than the headline benchmark gains alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, start with the introduction and Figure 1. The three takeaways to lock in early are: small models benefit more, perceptual tasks can get worse, and generic LLM TTS methods transfer surprisingly well. Then read the section defining the nine TTS methods and the evaluation setup, mainly to verify that the comparisons are budget-aware and fair. After that, spend most of the time on the attention analysis and token-budget analysis; these sections explain the overthinking failure mode. Finally, check the judge-based and human evaluation of reasoning chains to see whether the claims about chain quality are well supported. A solid skim should take around 35–45 minutes. If you only read a subset, prioritize Figure 1, the main result tables, and the sections discussing early visual attention decay.

recommendation.zh: 读结果表和规模分组就够；小模型吃到最多 TTS 红利这个结论会影响多模态推理算力分配。
recommendation.en: Read the size-stratified results; the claim that smaller strong LVLMs gain most from TTS changes inference-compute allocation priors.

paper.title: VisReflect: Latent Visual Reflection for Fine-Grained Perception in Long Visual Context
paper.abstract: Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success on vision-language tasks, yet fine-grained perception over high-resolution images and long-context videos remains challenging. As the number of visual tokens increases, the visual attention sink phenomenon becomes increasingly severe, causing irrelevant tokens to absorb a disproportionate amount of attention mass. Recent approaches attempt to mitigate this issue by explicitly predicting bounding boxes or temporal spans and re-

summary.core_problem: 在高分辨率图像与长视频这类“视觉 token 很长”的输入下，LVLM 的注意力会出现 visual attention sink：大量无关视觉 token 吸走注意力质量，导致小目标/局部细节与时间局部证据检索失败。现有“先预测框/时间段→再裁剪重编码”的两段式方案又同时受限于离散坐标预测不稳与二次 prefilling 带来的高延迟。论文要解决的是：能否不做显式裁剪与二次前向，仅在一次前向里把注意力重新聚焦到与问题相关的视觉证据上。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接相关性一般：它更像是 LVLM 推理/结构侧的证据检索机制改造，而不是预训练目标、数据配比、tokenizer 或训练动态层面的贡献。但它触及一个会反过来影响多模态预训练可扩展性的关键症结：当视觉 token 数量上去后，Transformer 的注意力分配会系统性退化，导致“堆更多视觉 token”并不等价于“获得更细粒度感知”。VisReflect 给出一种不依赖离散定位监督、也不引入多次视觉重编码的替代路径，适合作为长视觉上下文建模的工程化组件或 mid-train 插件思路。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把“定位”从离散坐标/时间段预测，改成在连续隐空间里生成一组 reflection embeddings（可理解为查询相关的视觉回忆向量）。流程上：视觉编码器产生视觉 token Z_v，经投影进入 LLM embedding 空间；文本 query 得到 Z_q。模型不输出 bbox/temporal span，而是生成若干反射 token（reflection tokens/embeddings），这些 token 在同一次 forward 的注意力中对原始视觉 token 形成强查询，从而把后续语言推理阶段的注意力质量重新分配到信息密度更高的区域/帧上。

与“Thinking-with-Images/Videos”类两段式方法的关键差异：
1) 监督信号形态不同：不需要把连续空间的定位问题硬塞进离散文本 token（坐标数字），减少对数值生成精度的敏感性。
2) 计算图不同：不需要第二次裁剪→视觉重编码→LLM prefilling，避免多次前向的延迟与算力开销。
3) 机制上更像“latent retrieval/latent routing”：用少量反射 token 作为中介，把长视觉序列中的稀疏证据“拉”到注意力中心，缓解 attention sink。

论文还强调对注意力图的分析：从 reflection token 指向原视觉 token 的注意力分布更集中，能解释性能提升来自更好的证据聚焦而非纯粹参数/算力堆叠。
summary.experiments:
覆盖高分辨率图像与长视频两类场景：
- 图像基准：BLINK、V*、HRBench。相对 base model 平均提升约 +4.1%。
- 视频基准：VideoMME、MLVU。相对强基线平均提升约 +1.8%。
- 效率：在视频场景下，与需要多次 forward 的“thinking-with-video/zooming”范式相比，性能可比但推理时间降低约 44%。

从摘要与正文片段可确认的定量信息主要是上述三组；更细的模型规模、reflection token 数量、不同长度/分辨率下的退化曲线、以及消融（例如 reflection token 放置位置、数量、是否共享参数、是否对齐到 query）需要在实验章节与附录表格里核对。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1) Introduction：把问题界定为 attention sink + 两段式裁剪的两类硬伤（数值定位不稳、二次 prefilling 成本）。
2) Method：重点看 reflection embeddings 如何生成、插入到序列的哪个位置、与原视觉 token 的注意力交互是怎样被“引导”的；同时留意它是否需要额外监督或仅靠端到端任务损失学习。
3) 实验部分优先看：与多次 zooming 的对比表（性能 vs 延迟），以及注意力可视化/定性案例，判断它是否真的在“检索证据”而不是改变 prompt 或解码策略。

如果要进一步评估其对预训练的启发：建议额外关注它在不同视觉 token 长度下的 scaling 行为（是否越长越占优），以及是否能作为通用模块迁移到不同 backbone/不同视觉 tokenizer。

summary_en.core_problem: LVLMs degrade on high-resolution images and long videos because attention mass collapses onto irrelevant visual tokens (visual attention sink) as the visual sequence grows. Prior “predict box/time span → crop/zoom → re-encode” pipelines partially fix this but are brittle (discrete numeric localization) and expensive (extra prefilling/forward passes). The paper targets a single-pass mechanism that can retrieve query-relevant visual evidence from massive visual token streams without explicit coordinate prediction or multi-pass re-encoding.
summary_en.importance: Moderate relevance to foundation-model pretraining: the contribution is primarily an inference-time / architectural retrieval mechanism for long visual contexts rather than a new pretraining objective, data recipe, tokenizer, or optimization insight. Still, it addresses a scaling bottleneck that matters for multimodal pretraining: increasing visual token count does not automatically yield finer perception if attention allocation systematically fails. The proposed latent-space “recall” interface is a plausible building block for long-context multimodal models and could influence how future pretraining setups expose and consume dense visual tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach:
VisReflect replaces discrete localization (bbox / temporal interval tokens) with continuous reflection embeddings generated in the model’s latent space. A vision encoder produces visual tokens Z_v, projected into the LLM embedding space; the text query yields Z_q. Instead of outputting coordinates and triggering a second cropped forward pass, the model generates a small set of reflection tokens that attend sharply to the original visual tokens within the same forward pass. These reflection tokens act as latent retrieval queries, pulling salient regions/frames into the model’s effective attention budget and mitigating attention sink.

Key differences vs. tool-using zoom/crop methods:
- No discrete numeric prediction for localization, reducing sensitivity to small coordinate errors.
- No second visual re-encoding / extra prefilling, improving latency and compute.
- Mechanistically closer to latent routing/retrieval: a compact intermediary token set reshapes attention over a long visual sequence.

The paper also uses attention-map analysis from reflection tokens to visual tokens to support the claim that gains come from better evidence focusing.
summary_en.experiments:
Benchmarks span high-res images and long videos:
- Image: BLINK, V*, HRBench, with ~+4.1% average improvement over the base model.
- Video: VideoMME, MLVU, with ~+1.8% average gain over strong baselines.
- Efficiency: comparable performance to multi-pass “thinking-with-video/zooming” while reducing video inference time by ~44%.

For deeper validation, the experimental section/appendix should be checked for: model/backbone details, number/placement of reflection tokens, ablations on token length and resolution, and robustness across different visual tokenizers/encoders.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Introduction: problem framing (attention sink) and critique of coordinate-based multi-pass zooming (brittleness + cost).
- Method: how reflection embeddings are produced, where they are inserted, and how they steer attention in a single forward pass; verify whether extra supervision is required.
- Experiments: focus on the table comparing accuracy vs. latency against multi-pass zooming, plus attention visualizations/qualitative cases.

If assessing pretraining implications, look specifically for scaling behavior with longer visual sequences and portability across backbones/tokenizers.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和 attention sink 消融即可；连续 latent 反思比 bbox 重编码更像可扩展的 VLM 长上下文接口。
recommendation.en: Read the method and attention-sink ablations; continuous latent reflection is a more scalable VLM long-context interface than bbox-based re-encoding.

paper.title: See Only When Needed: Context-Aware Attention Intervention for Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs

Prior training-free remedies often uniformly strengthen visual signals, which may also amplify irrelevant regions and introduce spurious evidence, harming fluency. We propose Context-aware Attention Intervention (CAI), a training-free inference-time mechanism that enforces a see only when needed principle via two-axis selectivity: where to look and when to intervene. At each decoding step, C

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）易产生对象幻觉，现有训练-free的缓解方法统一增强所有视觉信号，会放大无关区域干扰、引入虚假证据，损害文本生成流畅性。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出训练无关的推理时注意力干预机制，遵循「按需观察」原则，在不微调模型的前提下精准缓解幻觉并保留生成流畅性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出上下文感知注意力干预（CAI），实现双轴选择性干预：1）定位维度：每个解码步从模型浅层特征提取token级视觉相关性，定位与语义对齐的视觉区域；2）时机维度：仅对模型深层中不确定性突增的token，施加熵与深度门控的注意力倾斜，不干预高置信token与无关视觉区域。
summary.experiments: 现有摘要未披露具体实验设置（模型参数量/评测基准/提升幅度），仅声明方法可在多个LVLM基准上取得一致的幻觉缓解效果，且无需依赖对比解码即可生效。

summary_en.core_problem: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) are prone to object hallucinations; existing training-free mitigation methods uniformly strengthen all visual signals, amplifying irrelevant region interference, introducing spurious evidence, and harming generation fluency.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a training-agnostic inference-time attention intervention mechanism following the "see only when needed" principle, precisely mitigating hallucinations without fine-tuning while preserving fluency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Context-Aware Attention Intervention (CAI) with two-axis selectivity: 1) Localization: extract token-level visual relevance from early-layer features at each decoding step to locate semantically aligned visual regions; 2) Timing: apply entropy- and depth-gated attention tilting only to tokens with spiking uncertainty in deep layers, leaving high-confidence tokens and irrelevant regions untouched.
summary_en.experiments: The available abstract provides no specific experimental setup (model parameters, benchmarks, gain margins) and only claims consistent hallucination mitigation across multiple LVLM benchmarks, working without contrastive decoding.

recommendation.zh: LVLM幻觉缓解的推理时小技巧，选择性注意力干预的思路可参考，无预训练层面改动，扫读摘要与方法核心设计即可。
recommendation.en: Minor inference-time trick for LVLM hallucination mitigation; selective attention intervention design is referenceable, no pretraining-level changes, skim abstract and core method only.

paper.title: Dismantling Pathological Shortcuts: A Causal Framework for Faithful LVLM Decoding
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) exhibit sophisticated reasoning but remain susceptible to object hallucination. Deviating from the prevailing attention intensity assumption, we reveal a deeper dynamic structural misalignment: hallucination is triggered at decision-critical steps where specific attention heads, acting as risky mediators, decouple from visual evidence to lock onto language priors. This establishes a pathological shortcut that bypasses visual grounding. To dismantle this, we p

summary.core_problem: 解决大视觉语言模型（LVLM）中对象幻觉的问题，修正现有方法基于注意力强度假设的偏差。
summary.importance: 原理分析（揭示LVLM幻觉的新机制）+ 方法创新（训练自由的推理干预框架），修正了领域对幻觉成因的主流假设。
summary.technical_approach: 1）揭示幻觉源于决策关键步的特定注意力头（风险中介）与视觉证据脱钩、锁死语言先验的结构错位，而非注意力强度不足；2）提出Fox框架：用视觉注意力熵探针无监督定位风险中介，通过对数饱和做因果干预切断捷径，再用冲突门控协同解码平衡忠实度与流畅度。
summary.experiments: 在多个LVLM对象幻觉评测集上验证，显著降低幻觉率的同时保持生成流畅度；基于开源LVLM骨干做实验，未提及自训基座。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses object hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) and corrects biases in existing methods based on the attention intensity assumption.
summary_en.importance: Combines mechanism analysis (revealing a novel LVLM hallucination mechanism) with methodological innovation (training-free inference intervention framework), correcting the mainstream prior on hallucination causes.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Reveals hallucination stems from structural misalignment: specific attention heads (risky mediators) decouple from visual evidence and lock onto language priors at decision-critical steps, rather than insufficient attention intensity; 2) Proposes Fox: uses a visual attention entropy probe to unsupervisedly locate risky mediators, applies causal intervention via logit saturation to sever shortcuts, and uses a conflict-gated cooperative decoding strategy to balance faithfulness and fluency.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on multiple LVLM object hallucination benchmarks, significantly reducing hallucination rates while preserving generation fluency; experiments run on open-source LVLM backbones, no self-trained foundation models disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 推翻LVLM幻觉的注意力强度假设，结构错位的机制可直接指导预训练阶段的视觉-语言对齐头设计，重点读§3的机制分析。
recommendation.en: Overturns the attention intensity prior for LVLM hallucination; the structural misalignment mechanism can directly guide vision-language alignment head design during pretraining, focus on Section 3 mechanism analysis.

paper.title: GeMoE: Gating Entropy is All You Need for Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Routing in MoE-based Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: With the increase in model parameters and training data, the instruction following and generalization capabilities of Large VisionLanguage Models (LVLMs) have been significantly improved. Based on the Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, LVLMs expand their parameter capacity while maintaining the inference cost. However, traditional MoE methods employ a Top-k static routing strategy, which fails to account for variations in the input and adaptively select the number of experts, resulting in su

summary.core_problem: 解决 MoE 型大视觉语言模型中 Top-k 静态路由不能按输入难度自适应选择专家数量的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 MoE 路由机制改进。它把动态路由解释为最小描述长度问题，并尝试用 gating entropy 作为不确定性信号，在性能和计算之间做自适应折中。对 LLM 预训练的直接价值有限，但对 MoE 路由的训练和推理行为有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GeMoE，即 Gating Entropy-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Routing。方法核心是建立 MDL 与 MoE gating entropy 的联系，用门控分布熵估计 token 路由不确定性，再据此动态调整专家调用，而不是固定 Top-k 或使用手写启发式规则。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、训练数据、基线列表或提升幅度。可确认实验对象是 MoE-based LVLM，目标是在保持或改善性能的同时减少不必要专家调用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the rigidity of static Top-k routing in MoE-based large vision-language models, where different inputs may require different numbers of experts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an MoE routing mechanism rather than a pretraining recipe. It frames adaptive routing through a Minimum Description Length lens and uses gating entropy as an uncertainty signal to trade off predictive quality and routing cost. The direct impact on LLM pretraining is limited, but the routing signal is relevant to MoE design.
summary_en.technical_approach: GeMoE, or Gating Entropy-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Routing, connects MDL-style encoding cost with MoE gate entropy. Tokens with higher routing uncertainty can invoke more expert capacity, while easier tokens avoid unnecessary experts, replacing fixed Top-k or hand-crafted dynamic routing heuristics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, training data, baselines, or numerical gains. The experiments are described as targeting MoE-based LVLMs and evaluating adaptive expert usage under a performance-compute trade-off.

recommendation.zh: 只看路由熵和 MDL 的建模部分；若实验干净，可作为 MoE 动态容量分配的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the entropy-MDL routing formulation; if the ablations are clean, it is a weak signal for adaptive MoE capacity allocation.

paper.title: Benchmarking Large Vision-Language Models on Fine-Grained Image Tasks: From Evaluation to Diagnosis
paper.abstract: Recent advancements in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable multimodal perception and reasoning capabilities. While numerous benchmarks have evaluated LVLMs from holistic or task-specific perspectives, their capabilities on fine-grained image tasks-fundamental to computer vision-remain insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we introduce FG-BMK, a comprehensive fine-grained evaluation benchmark containing 1.01 million questions and 0.28 million images, coveri

summary.core_problem: 现有 LVLM 评测大多关注通用问答或粗粒度能力，缺少对细粒度图像理解能力的系统诊断；这篇工作试图建立一个能区分“视觉表征不足、视觉到语义映射薄弱、还是细粒度知识缺失”的评测框架。
summary.importance: 贡献类型主要是 benchmark 与诊断协议。对预训练研究员的价值在于：如果你在做原生多模态预训练、视觉 tokenizer、图文对齐或 unified multimodal model，这类细粒度失败模式比通用 VQA 分数更接近真正的表征瓶颈。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 FG-BMK，包含 101 万问题和 28 万图像，覆盖常见物体域到专业域。评测同时包含 dialogue-level 的细粒度语义识别，以及 feature-level 的视觉可分辨性测试；并通过 human-oriented 与 machine-oriented 两种范式，诊断失败究竟来自视觉 backbone/encoder 表征、跨模态 grounding，还是知识层面的缺口。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在一组代表性 LVLM/VLM 上做了大规模评测与诊断，但未在摘要中给出具体模型名单、参数规模、领先模型、或量化差距。已知资产规模较大，适合作为后续多模态预训练模型的分析基准，而不是方法论文去追单点提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包含 Serge Belongie。若正文机构信息无误，这通常意味着该工作在视觉识别与细粒度理解评测上有较强背景。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LVLM evaluations mostly emphasize generic QA or coarse-grained capabilities, leaving fine-grained image understanding poorly characterized. This work aims to build an evaluation framework that can disentangle failures due to weak visual representations, poor visual-semantic grounding, or missing fine-grained knowledge.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a benchmark plus diagnostic protocol. For pretraining researchers, the value is that if you work on native multimodal pretraining, visual tokenization, image-text alignment, or unified multimodal models, these fine-grained failure modes are often closer to the real representation bottlenecks than generic VQA scores.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces FG-BMK, with 1.01M questions and 0.28M images spanning common object-centric domains and specialized domains. It jointly evaluates dialogue-level fine-grained semantic recognition and feature-level visual discriminability, under both human-oriented and machine-oriented settings, to diagnose whether failures come from the visual encoder, cross-modal grounding, or knowledge limitations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the benchmark is used to evaluate a diverse set of representative LVLMs/VLMs at scale, but does not provide exact model names, parameter counts, top performers, or quantitative gaps. The asset is large enough to matter as an analysis benchmark rather than a method paper chasing a narrow gain.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Serge Belongie. If the affiliation details in the paper confirm it, that usually signals strong background in visual recognition and fine-grained evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做多模态预训练，只看 benchmark 设计和 failure taxonomy 就够了；正文大概率偏评测堆表，不必逐项细读。
recommendation.en: If you work on multimodal pretraining, read the benchmark design and failure taxonomy only; the rest is likely mostly leaderboard-style evaluation.

paper.title: One Layer's Trash is Another Layer's Treasure: Adaptive Layer-wise Visual Token Selection in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse multimodal tasks, yet their practical deployment remains constrained by the computational burden arising from lengthy visual tokens. While visual token pruning has emerged as a promising solution, existing methods suffer from a fundamental limitation: once tokens are pruned at a specific layer, they become inaccessible to all subsequent layers, leading to premature information loss that can compromise model perf

summary.core_problem: 降低 LVLM 中长视觉 token 序列带来的推理计算负担，同时避免一次性剪枝造成后续层无法恢复关键信息。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态大模型推理效率方法，不是预训练范式；有价值的点在于指出不同层需要的视觉区域不同，静态 token pruning 的“剪掉即永久丢失”假设过强。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ALVTS，即 Adaptive Layer-wise Visual Token Selection。方法在各层引入轻量 token selector，为当前层选择需要继续参与计算的重要视觉 token；低重要性 token 不是永久删除，而是跳过当前层或以路由方式减少计算，使后续层仍可根据自身需求访问不同 token 子集。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、具体 LVLM backbone、数据集和加速/精度数字；实验应与静态视觉 token pruning 方法比较，关注多模态任务精度、FLOPs/latency 降低和不同层 token 选择模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the inference cost of LVLMs caused by long visual-token sequences while avoiding irreversible information loss from one-shot pruning.
summary_en.importance: This is an LVLM inference-efficiency contribution rather than a pretraining method. The useful observation is that different layers attend to different visual regions, making static pruning too rigid.
summary_en.technical_approach: ALVTS introduces a lightweight token selector at each layer. Important visual tokens are routed for further computation, while less important ones can skip selected layers instead of being permanently removed, allowing later layers to use a different token subset.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, backbones, datasets, or exact speed/accuracy numbers. The key experiments are expected to compare against static visual-token pruning on multimodal accuracy and compute or latency reduction.

recommendation.zh: 只看层间 token 重要性分析即可；方法像动态 MoE 路由的视觉版，结论对 VLM serving 比 pretrain 更有用。
recommendation.en: Read only the layer-wise token-importance analysis; the method is a visual-token routing variant, more useful for VLM serving than pretraining.

paper.title: Disentangling Visual and Factual Correctness in LVLMs' Visualization Literacy
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) show strong visualization interpretation, yet it is unclear whether their responses reflect genuine reasoning over visual evidence or factual priors learned during training. Current evaluations mix these two sources, obscuring when correct visual interpretation is overridden by memorized facts. We present a framework that isolates visual correctness from factual correctness, revealing validity limitations in existing visualization literacy assessments. Across

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“LVLM 会不会看图表”这么宽泛的问题，而是现有图表理解评测到底在测什么。作者指出，标准可视化素养测试把两种能力混在了一起：一是从图中读出编码关系的视觉正确性，二是调用世界知识给出事实正确性的能力。两者一致时，模型答对并不能说明它真的读懂了图；两者冲突时，模型答错也无法判断是视觉解析失败，还是看懂了图却被预训练事实先验覆盖。论文的核心问题，就是把这两种正确性拆开，单独测量 LVLM 在视觉证据与事实先验冲突时如何仲裁。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在评测信号质量，而不是提出新的预训练方法。它提醒一个很实际的问题：多模态模型在图表、表格、文档等“带强世界知识先验”的任务上，常见 accuracy 可能高估了视觉理解能力。对预训练研究员来说，这关系到两个判断：第一，训练数据中的事实记忆会如何污染多模态能力评估；第二，当模型面对冲突证据时，系统行为更像“感知模型”还是“知识检索器”。这类诊断框架对后续做原生多模态预训练、视觉 token 设计、以及 instruction tuning 是否削弱视觉 grounding，都有参考价值。但它仍然是评测论文，贡献量级主要体现在把问题定义清楚、构造了更干净的诊断基准，而不是直接改变训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三层。第一层是概念框架：把回答结果拆成 visual correctness 和 factual correctness 两个维度，而不是只看最终是否答对。第二层是三组评测设计。其一，用 VLAT 测标准图表理解表现；其二，用 reVLAT 通过随机化内容、尽量保留视觉编码结构来削弱事实先验的帮助，用来更接近纯视觉解析；其三，提出 CVLAT，系统构造“图上编码”和“现实事实”相冲突的反事实图表，例如故意交换行星直径等数值，让模型必须在视觉证据与记忆知识之间做选择。第三层是提示干预实验，分别给 factual-priority 和 visual-priority 提示，观察模型偏好能否被稳定转向。论文的关键点不在复杂模型，而在 benchmark construction 和 error attribution：它把过去一个混合指标拆成了可诊断的行为维度。与已有 VLAT/reVLAT 相比，C VLAT 不再只问模型答得对不对，而是直接测冲突条件下的 arbitration behavior。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 15 个当前 LVLM，包含闭源和开源模型。论文给出的主要结论有三点。第一，一些模型在标准 VLAT 上已经接近人类水平，但这种成绩并不稳固，因为在 reVLAT 或冲突设置下会明显下降，说明原先成绩部分来自事实先验而非纯视觉理解。第二，在 CVLAT 上，多数模型在视觉证据与事实知识冲突时，倾向优先输出事实上“应该正确”的答案，而不是图中实际编码出的答案；也就是说，它们常常会覆盖视觉证据。第三，prompt steering 只能有限改变这种偏好，视觉优先或事实优先提示会带来一定移动，但不足以稳定、彻底地重排模型的内部优先级，说明这种仲裁更像模型内生倾向，而不是简单的表层指令服从。就阅读价值而言，最该关注的不是单个榜单名次，而是三种测试之间的性能落差，以及作者如何把“答对”进一步分解成不同来源的正确性。你给出的全文片段没有保留完整数值表，因此这里不虚构具体百分点；建议直接看主表和附录中的模型分项结果、提示干预前后变化幅度，以及不同图表类型上的一致性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先抓问题定义，再看实验设计。优先看 Introduction 里 Figure 1 对冲突场景的例子，这个例子基本把整篇文章的动机讲清楚。然后看方法部分对 visual correctness / factual correctness 的定义，以及 CVLAT 的构造原则，确认作者如何避免把“反事实图表”做成无意义噪声。实验部分重点看三组结果：VLAT vs reVLAT 的差距、CVLAT 上的偏好分布、prompt intervention 的有效性。若时间有限，先看主文中的总表和案例分析，预计 20–30 分钟能把核心结论读明白；如果要判断 benchmark 是否可复用，再看附录里的数据构造细节、题型分布和人工校验流程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not simply asking whether LVLMs can read charts. It asks a more precise question: what do current chart-understanding benchmarks actually measure? Existing evaluations conflate two different sources of correctness: visual correctness, meaning the model correctly reads the visual encoding, and factual correctness, meaning the answer matches real-world knowledge memorized during pretraining. When the two align, a correct answer may come from factual recall rather than visual grounding. When they conflict, an incorrect answer does not tell us whether the model failed to read the chart or read it correctly but overrode the evidence with prior knowledge. The core problem is to disentangle these two axes and diagnose how LVLMs arbitrate between visual evidence and factual priors.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in evaluation quality rather than in a new pretraining recipe. For foundation-model research, this matters because multimodal benchmarks often overestimate visual understanding when tasks contain strong world-knowledge priors. The paper gives a cleaner lens on two issues: how pretrained factual memory contaminates multimodal evaluation, and whether a model behaves more like a grounded perceptual system or a knowledge-driven responder under evidence conflict. That is relevant to native multimodal pretraining, chart/document understanding, and to studying whether instruction tuning weakens or preserves visual grounding. The contribution is diagnostic and methodological: it sharpens the measurement problem and introduces a benchmark that isolates a failure mode hidden by standard accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three layers. First, it introduces a conceptual framework that separates visual correctness from factual correctness instead of collapsing them into a single accuracy number. Second, it evaluates models with three complementary settings. VLAT measures standard visualization literacy. reVLAT randomizes content while preserving visual encodings to reduce the usefulness of factual priors and better approximate pure visual decoding. CVLAT, the new benchmark, explicitly creates counterfactual charts where the displayed values conflict with real-world facts, forcing the model to choose between what it sees and what it knows. Third, the paper studies prompt-based preference steering by comparing factual-priority and visual-priority instructions. The key contribution is not a new model architecture but benchmark construction and behavioral attribution: it turns a previously entangled outcome into a diagnosable arbitration problem.
summary_en.experiments: The study evaluates 15 state-of-the-art LVLMs, including both proprietary and open-source systems. Three findings stand out. First, several models reach near-human performance on standard VLAT, but that performance is not stable once factual priors are controlled or contradicted, indicating that standard scores partly reflect memorized knowledge rather than grounded chart reading. Second, on CVLAT, many models prefer factually plausible answers over visually supported ones when the two conflict, showing a systematic tendency to override visual evidence with pretrained priors. Third, prompt interventions can shift behavior somewhat, but not reliably enough to fully reverse the preference, suggesting that the arbitration pattern is not just a superficial prompting artifact. The most informative result is not the leaderboard itself but the gap across VLAT, reVLAT, and CVLAT. The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so it is better to inspect the main result tables and appendix directly for exact margins, per-model breakdowns, and prompt-steering deltas.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the motivating example in the introduction, especially the counterfactual chart scenario, because it captures the entire paper in one case. Then read the section defining visual correctness and factual correctness, followed by the construction details of CVLAT. In the experiments, focus on three comparisons: VLAT versus reVLAT, model behavior on CVLAT under conflict, and the effect size of prompt steering. For a quick pass, the main figures, benchmark examples, and aggregate result tables are enough to understand the contribution in about 20 to 30 minutes. If you want to judge whether the benchmark is reusable, spend extra time on the appendix sections covering data construction, chart types, annotation checks, and failure-case analysis.

recommendation.zh: VLM评测方向的有趣工作，揭示了fact vs visual 混淆问题。对LLM研究员可借鉴其反事实评测设计思路，但非核心关注，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Interesting VLM evaluation work revealing fact-vs-visual confound. LLM researchers can learn from counterfactual evaluation design, but not core focus. Read abstract only.

paper.title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-model-based graphical user interface (GUI) agents have shown broad automation capabilities, yet deployment is bottlenecked by a key-value (KV) cache that grows linearly with interaction steps. For instance, UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76 GB of GPU memory on merely five screenshots, approaching the capacity of mainstream 80 GB accelerators. Existing KV compression methods share two structural assumptions: aggregating visual-token importance into a single shared saliency map, and apply

summary.core_problem: 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的 GUI 智能体在处理多帧高分辨率截图时，KV Cache 会随交互步数线性增长，导致显存耗尽（如 UI-TARS-1.5-7B 处理 5 张截图即消耗 76GB 显存）。现有的 KV Cache 压缩方法假设所有注意力头共享单一显著性图，且采用固定的 Top-B 截断策略，这在 GUI 场景下会导致空间布局信息丢失和分布漂移问题。
summary.importance: 揭示了 GUI 场景下注意力机制的两个核心特性：子空间级别的空间特化（Spatial Specialization）和随时间步漂移的注意力熵（Entropy Drift）。提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的 KV Cache 压缩方案，为长上下文 GUI 智能体的部署提供了实用的显存优化手段。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STaR-KV 框架，包含三个核心机制：1) 在线空间分析（Online Spatial Profiling）：计算注意力子空间与 2D 屏幕坐标的互信息，保留对布局敏感的子空间信息；2) 累积时间稳定性衰减（Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount）：根据子空间在多帧间的稳定性，对历史视觉 Token 进行加权，抑制静态 UI 元素的冗余缓存，保留动态组件的 Token；3) 自适应熵锐化（Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening）：根据注意力分布的归一化熵动态调整温度参数，替代固定的 Top-B 截断，在平缓分布下避免任意截断，在尖峰分布下增强选择性。
summary.experiments: 在多个 GUI 智能体基准测试上，STaR-KV 无需微调即可应用于 UI-TARS 和 OpenCUA 等模型。在相同的显存预算下，其平均性能优于现有的 SOTA KV 压缩方法（如 GUIKV、SnapKV）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中的 Pilot 1 和 Pilot 2，这两个实验清晰地揭示了现有方法的盲区。Method 部分详细阐述了三个核心机制的实现细节，特别是互信息的计算和自适应熵锐化的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: GUI agents based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face severe memory bottlenecks due to the linear growth of KV cache with interaction steps when processing multiple high-resolution screenshots (e.g., UI-TARS-1.5-7B consumes 76GB for just 5 screenshots). Existing KV cache compression methods assume a shared saliency map across all attention heads and apply a fixed Top-B cutoff, which leads to the loss of spatial layout information and distribution drift issues in GUI scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Reveals two core characteristics of attention mechanisms in GUI scenarios: subspace-level spatial specialization and entropy drift over time steps. Proposes a training-free, plug-and-play KV cache compression scheme, providing a practical memory optimization solution for deploying long-context GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the STaR-KV framework, featuring three core mechanisms: 1) Online Spatial Profiling: Calculates the mutual information between attention subspaces and 2D screen coordinates to preserve layout-sensitive subspace information; 2) Cumulative Temporal Stability Discount: Weights historical visual tokens based on the stability of their governing subspaces across frames, suppressing redundant cache entries from static UI elements while preserving tokens of dynamic components; 3) Adaptive Entropy-Based Sharpening (AEB): Dynamically adjusts the temperature parameter based on the normalized entropy of the attention distribution, replacing the fixed Top-B cutoff to avoid arbitrary truncation in flat distributions and enhance selectivity in peaky ones.
summary_en.experiments: Across multiple GUI agent benchmarks, STaR-KV can be directly applied to models like UI-TARS and OpenCUA without fine-tuning. Under matched memory budgets, it achieves stronger average performance than SOTA KV compression methods (e.g., GUIKV, SnapKV).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Pilot 1 and Pilot 2 in the Introduction, which clearly reveal the blind spots of existing methods. The Method section details the implementation of the three core mechanisms, especially the calculation of mutual information and the design of adaptive entropy sharpening.

recommendation.zh: 只看 pilot measurements 和压缩策略即可；它对“统一视觉 saliency + 固定 top-B”的反例比较有用。
recommendation.en: Read the pilot measurements and compression policy; the useful part is the counterexample to global visual saliency plus fixed top-B pruning.

paper.title: YARD: Y-Architecture Register Decoding for Efficient Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Contrastive decoding (CD) seeks to mitigate hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) by contrasting the output distributions of a standard model and a visually degraded model. However, existing training-free CD methods suffer from sub-optimal degraded branches: completely dropping visual tokens is too extreme and induces language hallucinations, while corrupting input images offers coarse control over visual evidence and suffers from high inference latency due to requiring two full

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 幻觉缓解中 contrastive decoding 需要双分支完整前向、退化分支过粗且推理代价高的问题。
summary.importance: 属于训练后、推理期的 VLM 解码改造。对“中层视觉 grounding 更关键”和“内部构造退化分支”这两个点有一定方法启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出训练自由的 Y-Architecture Register Decoding。方法在解码器浅层共享计算，到中间层再分叉；退化分支不再丢弃视觉 token 或破坏输入图像，而是用 register token 替换 patch token，以保留全局语义但削弱细粒度视觉证据，再做对比分布解码。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称相比现有 CD 方法能降低推理延迟并更有效缓解幻觉，但未给出具体模型、数据集和提升幅度。可预期 baseline 是视觉 token drop、图像 corruption 等 training-free CD 方案。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inefficiency and poor degraded-branch design of contrastive decoding for hallucination mitigation in large vision-language models.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time VLM decoding paper. It offers some useful signals—especially that grounding may concentrate in middle layers and that degraded branches can be built internally—but it is still far from core pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes a training-free Y-Architecture Register Decoding method. It shares shallow-layer computation, branches at a middle decoder stage, and replaces patch-level visual tokens with register tokens in the degraded branch to preserve global semantics while weakening fine-grained visual evidence, then performs contrastive decoding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims lower inference latency and better hallucination mitigation than existing CD methods, but gives no concrete model sizes, datasets, or gains. Likely baselines are visual-token dropping and image corruption based training-free CD variants.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“grounding 主要出现在中层”这个观察值得记一笔；只看方法图和消融，别投入太多时间。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that grounding concentrates in middle layers is worth noting; read the method figure and ablations, not the full paper.

paper.title: What Makes LVLMs Hallucinate Less? Unveiling the Architectural Factors Behind Hallucination Robustness
paper.abstract: Hallucination remains one of the key challenges undermining the reliability of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). But what makes an LVLM hallucinate less? Many existing efforts focus on improving internal components of the model. We argue that hallucination fundamentally stems from how the model architecture is designed. To investigate this, we factor the architecture design into three dimensions: Linguistic Foundation (LF), Visual Representation (VR), and Semantic Alignment (SA), and categor

summary.core_problem: 分析 LVLM 幻觉与模型架构设计之间的关系，试图回答哪些架构因素会让多模态模型更不容易产生幻觉。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLM 幻觉评测与架构因素分析。它把幻觉拆成语言基础、视觉表示、语义对齐三个设计维度，并提出 CoSimUE 基准来构造细粒度幻觉场景；对 VLM 预训练和对齐有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将架构因素分解为 Linguistic Foundation、Visual Representation、Semantic Alignment 三类，并把幻觉划分为 Co-occurrence、Similarity、Uncertainty 三类。CoSimUE 通过受控文本扰动与随机扰动构造样本，用于观察不同设计选择与幻觉行为之间的映射关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明实验覆盖 7 个设计方面，并得到一个主要观察：单纯扩大模型参数量对降低三类幻觉的作用有限。摘要未给出模型清单、参数规模、数据量、baseline 或具体数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自四川大学、厦门理工学院、香港大学等；摘要中的机构信息格式不完整，无法确认更具体团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how LVLM architectural choices affect hallucination robustness, asking which design factors make a vision-language model hallucinate less.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an LVLM hallucination benchmark and architectural-factor analysis. It decomposes design into linguistic foundation, visual representation, and semantic alignment, and introduces CoSimUE to create fine-grained hallucination scenarios. The relevance to VLM pretraining and alignment is indirect but real.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors factor architecture into Linguistic Foundation, Visual Representation, and Semantic Alignment, and categorize hallucinations into co-occurrence, similarity, and uncertainty types. CoSimUE uses controlled textual perturbations and random perturbations to map design choices to hallucination behaviors.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports experiments over seven design aspects and highlights that parameter scaling alone has limited effect on reducing all three hallucination types. It does not provide the model list, parameter scales, data size, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are associated with Sichuan University, Xiamen University of Technology, and the University of Hong Kong, but the provided affiliation text is incomplete.

recommendation.zh: 结论方向合理但信息不足；只看参数规模对幻觉影响有限这条，别把它当干净因果实验。
recommendation.en: The direction is plausible but underspecified; note the limited effect of parameter scaling on hallucination, but do not treat it as a clean causal study.
