paper.title: PARCEL: Pool-Anchored Resampling with Conditioned Elastic Queries for Efficient Vision-Language Understanding
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) map visual inputs into dense token sequences, imposing a quadratic computational bottleneck for inference. Elastic visual-token compression addresses this by training a single model that can run at multiple visual-token budgets. However, existing approaches struggle under aggressive compression. Spatial-only compression, as in nested pooling, behaves as an imperfect low-pass filter and induces spectral aliasing that obscures fine-grained detail. Query-only co

summary.core_problem: 降低 LVLM 视觉 token 序列过长带来的推理计算开销，同时在强压缩下保留空间定位和细粒度视觉信息。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态推理效率与视觉 tokenization 架构改进。它对 native VLM 预训练有间接价值，因为视觉 token 预算和 token 表示形态会影响跨模态统一建模的成本与能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PARCEL，即 Pool-Anchored Resampling with Conditioned Elastic Queries。方法把视觉 token 分成两类职责：spatial pool tokens 作为低频布局锚点，conditioned elastic queries 负责补充细粒度和任务相关信息。论文认为纯空间压缩类似低通滤波，会带来频谱混叠；纯 query resampling 则会削弱显式网格对齐和空间 grounding。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型参数量、训练数据规模或数值提升。实验目标应是比较 PARCEL 与 nested pooling、nested query resampling 等 elastic visual-token compression 方法，在不同视觉 token 预算下的 LVLM 理解性能和空间 grounding 表现。
summary.authors_note: Bernt Schiele 是计算机视觉领域知名研究者，长期工作包括视觉表示学习、场景理解和多模态感知；Federico Tombari 长期从事 3D 视觉与视觉表示相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to reduce the inference cost of LVLMs caused by dense visual-token sequences while preserving fine detail and spatial grounding under aggressive compression.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an efficient visual-tokenization architecture for vision-language understanding. It is only indirectly tied to LLM pretraining, but it matters for native multimodal models because visual-token budgets shape both training cost and representation quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: PARCEL splits the role of compressed visual tokens. Spatial pool tokens act as low-frequency layout anchors, while conditioned elastic queries add fine-grained, task-sensitive information. The paper frames spatial-only compression as an imperfect low-pass filter with aliasing, and query-only compression as a source of degraded grid alignment and grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide parameter counts, training scale, or numerical gains. The intended comparisons are against elastic visual-token compression baselines such as nested pooling and nested query resampling across different visual-token budgets, with attention to understanding quality and spatial grounding.
summary_en.authors_note: Bernt Schiele is a well-known computer vision researcher with work on visual representation learning and scene understanding. Federico Tombari is known for work in 3D vision and visual representations.

recommendation.zh: 读视觉 token 分工假设即可；若在做 native VLM 预训练，PARCEL 可作为压缩 tokenizer 备选。
recommendation.en: Skim the visual-token division of labor; for native VLM pretraining, PARCEL is a plausible compressed-tokenizer option.

paper.title: Risk-aware Selective Prompting for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Prompt-based verification is widely used to mitigate hallucinations in large vision-language models (LVLMs), yet when it helps remains poorly understood. We systematically study verification prompting across two representative LVLM architectures and hallucination benchmarks, and find that it is a risk-bearing intervention: its corrections increase with input difficulty, while newly introduced errors persist across difficulty levels. As a result, always-on prompting helps on hard inputs but offer

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM hallucination verification prompting 什么时候有效，并避免在简单样本上因额外提示引入新错误。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LVLM hallucination mitigation 的分析和轻量方法。它的主要价值不是 prompt trick 本身，而是指出 verification prompting 会带来输入难度相关的风险，并用注意力与熵模式解释这种风险。
summary.technical_approach: 论文系统比较 verification prompting 在不同难度输入上的收益和副作用，发现它在困难样本上纠错更多，但在各难度上都会引入新错误。基于这一点提出 Risk-aware Selective Prompting：只在风险或难度较高时启用 verification prompt，而不是 always-on。机制分析显示 verification prompt 会让注意力从视觉 token 转向 instruction token，并产生中层熵模式变化，体现 conservative output shift。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类代表性 LVLM 架构和 hallucination benchmark。结果显示 always-on verification prompting 对困难输入有帮助，但对简单输入收益有限甚至有害；选择性启用能降低新增错误。摘要未给出模型名称、benchmark 名称和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when verification prompting reduces hallucination in large vision-language models, and how to avoid introducing errors on easy inputs.
summary_en.importance: This is an analysis and lightweight mitigation method for LVLM hallucination. The value is less in the prompting heuristic itself and more in the risk analysis: verification prompts are input-dependent interventions that can trade corrections for newly introduced errors.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate verification prompting across input difficulty levels and find that it corrects more on hard cases while still introducing errors across difficulty levels. They propose risk-aware selective prompting, enabling verification prompts only when the input appears risky. Mechanistic probes show attention shifting from visual tokens toward instruction tokens and a middle-layer entropy pattern, suggesting a conservative output shift rather than uniformly better visual grounding.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers two representative LVLM architectures and hallucination benchmarks. Always-on verification helps harder inputs but provides little benefit or can hurt easier inputs; selective prompting reduces unnecessary intervention. The abstract does not provide model names, benchmark names, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 看机制分析图即可；它提醒 verification prompt 可能是在改写决策先验，不是在增强视觉 grounding。
recommendation.en: Skim the mechanism plots; the useful warning is that verification prompts may shift decision priors rather than improve visual grounding.

paper.title: Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement for LVLM Hallucination Mitigation
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have advanced multimodal understanding, yet their reliability is limited by hallucination, where generated content conflicts with visual facts. Existing mitigation methods either rely on costly external interventions, such as instruction tuning and retrieval, or use internal mechanisms that remain limited by flawed attention weights and entangled hidden representations. We propose Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement (AOD), a latent geometric framework for

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 LVLM 幻觉缓解问题：模型生成的文本与图像事实不一致。作者关注的是不重新训练大模型、不依赖外部检索的内部干预方法，尤其是如何避免在抑制幻觉时损伤正常视觉语义能力。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更偏向后训练与推理期干预。但它有一个有用启发：幻觉相关信号可能能在隐藏空间中被压缩到少数方向，而事实语义保留在正交残差空间中。这个视角可用于分析多模态模型的表示解耦、训练信号污染、以及 activation steering 对能力保持的影响。它也提醒，直接用注意力裁剪或二分类器处理隐藏状态，可能会把有用视觉语义和幻觉偏置一起处理掉。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement。给定图像、问题和真实答案，作者从 LVLM 某一层的 final token hidden state 提取表示。AOD 学习一个投影方向，使一致性分类器把与幻觉相关的预测信号集中到该方向上；同时通过 Gradient Reversal Layer 引入对抗目标，迫使正交残差空间尽量去除这些幻觉可预测信号。这样得到一个较干净的幻觉方向。推理时不重新训练 LVLM，而是做 activation-steered contrastive decoding：沿该方向构造一个更容易幻觉的表示和一个更偏事实的表示，再通过双前向的 logits 对比惩罚幻觉 token。与注意力剪枝不同，它不依赖可能已经失真的注意力权重；与普通隐藏态分类器不同，它显式约束幻觉方向与语义残差的几何分离。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在多个 LVLM 架构和多个幻觉评测上优于已有内部干预方法。主要数字包括：POPE 平均提升约 +6.4%，AMBER 平均提升约 +6.0%；同时 OCRBench 提升约 +10.4%，用于说明幻觉抑制没有明显牺牲通用视觉文本能力。作者还报告学到的幻觉方向有零样本迁移能力：从单一分布抽取后，可迁移到不同难度和不同幻觉类型，包括物体、属性和关系幻觉。需要注意的是，这类结果依赖所选层、投影维度、对比解码强度和评测集分布，泛化到开放式生成场景仍需谨慎验证。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 AOD 的目标函数、正交分解、GRL 对抗训练，以及 inference-time contrastive decoding。实验部分重点看 POPE、AMBER、OCRBench 的能力保持结果和迁移实验。若只关心预训练，可跳过大部分应用性评测，关注隐藏空间中幻觉方向是否稳定、是否跨模型共享、以及该方向与视觉 grounding token 或语言先验之间的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses hallucination in LVLMs, where generated text conflicts with visual evidence. It targets internal interventions that do not require full model retraining or external retrieval, with a particular focus on reducing hallucinations without damaging useful visual semantics.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training and inference-time control than to core pretraining. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers is the geometric view of hallucination: hallucination-prone information may be concentrated into a small latent direction, while factual visual semantics can be preserved in the orthogonal residual space. This offers a way to probe multimodal representations, understand entanglement between language priors and visual grounding, and evaluate whether activation steering preserves capability rather than merely making outputs conservative.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, Adversarial Orthogonal Disentanglement, extracts hidden states from a selected LVLM layer at the final token position for image-question inputs. It learns a projection direction that concentrates hallucination-predictive signals, while an adversarial objective with a Gradient Reversal Layer removes those signals from the orthogonal residual subspace. The result is a learned hallucination direction with a cleaner separation from general visual semantics. At inference time, the base LVLM is not retrained. Instead, the method performs activation-steered contrastive decoding: hidden states are shifted along the learned direction to form hallucination-amplified and factual-steered representations, and the resulting logits are contrasted to penalize hallucination-prone continuations. Compared with attention pruning, it does not rely on potentially faulty attention weights. Compared with a plain classifier on hidden states, it explicitly enforces a separation between the hallucination direction and semantic residual.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports consistent gains across multiple LVLM architectures and hallucination benchmarks. The headline numbers are average improvements of about +6.4% on POPE and +6.0% on AMBER. It also reports a +10.4% improvement on OCRBench, used as evidence that the intervention does not simply suppress generation or remove useful visual information. The learned hallucination direction is reported to transfer zero-shot from one distribution to other difficulty levels and hallucination types, including object, attribute, and relation hallucinations. The main caveat is that such interventions can be sensitive to layer choice, steering strength, projection design, and benchmark distribution; open-ended generation still needs careful validation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the methodology sections on the adversarial objective, orthogonal decomposition, Gradient Reversal Layer, and contrastive decoding. In the experiments, focus on POPE, AMBER, OCRBench, and the transfer studies. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful part is not the benchmark ranking but the evidence for a stable hallucination direction and its relation to visual grounding and language-prior dominance.

recommendation.zh: 通过在 latent 空间做对抗正交解耦来寻找幻觉方向并用于对比解码，对理解 VLM 的内部表征和免训练干预有启发，值得看其解耦机制的设计。
recommendation.en: Finding hallucination directions via adversarial orthogonal disentanglement in the latent space for contrastive decoding; provides insights into VLM internal representations and training-free interventions, worth skimming for its disentanglement mechanism.

paper.title: Finding the Correct Visual Evidence Without Forgetting: Mitigating Hallucination in LVLMs via Inter-Layer Visual Attention Discrepancy
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have shown remarkable performance on a wide range of vision-language tasks. Despite this progress, they are still prone to hallucination, generating responses that are inconsistent with visual content. In this work, we find that LVLMs tend to hallucinate when they pay insufficient attention to the correct visual evidence and gradually forget it during the generation process. We empirically find that although LVLMs overall attend insufficiently to visual evide

summary.core_problem: 缓解 LVLM 在生成回答时忽略或遗忘正确视觉证据，从而产生与图像不一致内容的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LVLM 幻觉机制观察与推理期缓解方法。它不直接推进预训练，但对视觉 token 在 decoder 层间如何被使用、以及多模态对齐信号为何失效有一定诊断价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ILVAD。方法先收集生成早期 token 到视觉 token 的跨层 attention 权重，利用层间视觉注意力差异找出反复被激活的视觉证据 token，形成 saliency map；随后增强这些视觉证据，减少生成过程中对关键视觉信息的遗忘。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 LVLM backbone、评测数据集、幻觉指标、baseline 或提升幅度。需要重点检查其是否只依赖 attention 作为解释信号，以及在 CHAIR、POPE、MME hallucination 等常见评测上的泛化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper mitigates LVLM hallucination caused by insufficient attention to, or gradual forgetting of, correct visual evidence during generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a hallucination mechanism observation with an inference-time mitigation method. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is relevant to how decoder layers use visual tokens and why multimodal alignment signals fail.
summary_en.technical_approach: ILVAD collects attention weights from early generated tokens to visual tokens across layers, identifies repeatedly activated visual tokens as evidence, builds a saliency map, and enhances these evidence tokens to reduce forgetting during generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the LVLM backbones, evaluation datasets, hallucination metrics, baselines, or quantitative gains. The key checks are whether attention is a reliable evidence signal and whether gains generalize across common hallucination evaluations such as CHAIR, POPE, or MME-style benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 只看层间 attention discrepancy 的实证图；若没有干预消融和跨模型复现，别把它当机制结论。
recommendation.en: Read only the inter-layer attention discrepancy evidence; without intervention ablations and cross-model replication, do not treat it as mechanism.

paper.title: Reducing Object Hallucination in LVLMs via Emphasizing Image-negative Tokens
paper.abstract: Object hallucination is a significant challenge that hinders the application of large vision-language models (LVLMs) in practice. We hypothesize that one possible origin of hallucination is the model's tendency to prioritize text generation over meaningful interaction with images. To explore this, we examine the generation process and categorize text tokens into three groups: image-positive, invariant, and negative, based on their visual dependence on input image tokens. Our analysis reveals tha

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 在生成时过度依赖语言先验、忽视图像证据，从而产生物体幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是多模态训练信号分析和训练损失改造：作者把生成 token 按视觉依赖程度分组，指出大量 token 对图像输入不敏感，并用 token 级重加权和疑似幻觉数据过滤来抑制幻觉。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先分析生成过程中不同文本 token 对图像 token 的依赖，将其划分为 image-positive、invariant、image-negative 三类；随后根据视觉依赖程度调整训练权重，让训练更强调真正需要图像证据的 token，并移除一部分可能包含更多幻觉的训练样本。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练数据规模、baseline 名称和数值提升；实验重点应是 LVLM 物体幻觉评测，以及 token 重加权和数据过滤对幻觉率的影响。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Nanyang Technological University 和 Monash University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses object hallucination in LVLMs caused by generation that relies more on language priors than on visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an analysis of multimodal training signals and a token-level loss intervention: generated tokens are grouped by visual dependence, and the authors argue that many tokens are only weakly affected by image inputs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method analyzes how much each generated text token depends on image tokens, categorizes tokens into image-positive, invariant, and image-negative groups, then reweights training losses according to visual dependence and filters training samples that may contain more hallucinated content.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, data scale, baselines, or numeric gains. The likely evaluation focuses on LVLM object hallucination benchmarks and ablations for token reweighting and data filtering.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Nanyang Technological University and Monash University.

paper.title: Do We Really Need External Tools to Mitigate Hallucinations? SIRA: Shared-Prefix Internal Reconstruction of Attribution
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate when language priors dominate weak or ambiguous visual evidence. Existing contrastive decoding methods mitigate this problem by comparing predictions from the original image with those from externally perturbed visual inputs, but such references can introduce off-manifold artifacts and require costly extra forward passes. We propose SIRA, a training-free internal contrastive decoding framework that constructs a counterfactual reference insid

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LVLM 解码阶段的幻觉抑制问题：不依赖外部图像扰动或额外模型，能否在模型内部构造一个对照分支，用来区分视觉证据支持的 token 和语言先验驱动的 token。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，主要价值在于提供了一个观察多模态 Transformer 信息流的实用视角。它提示一个问题：视觉 grounding 不是只发生在输入层，早期层可能完成语义对齐，后期层继续使用图像 token 做细粒度决策。因此，构造反事实 reference 时，直接遮挡输入图像可能破坏对齐；在中后层限制 image-token access，可能得到更干净的语言先验参照。
summary.technical_approach: SIRA 是 training-free 的内部 contrastive decoding。标准分支执行正常多模态推理；反事实分支与标准分支共享 prompt、参数、解码历史、位置结构和早期层计算。在选定 split boundary 之后，反事实分支被禁止继续 attend 到 image-token positions。这样两个分支都保留早期图文对齐状态，但后续 token 预测中只有标准分支还能访问细粒度视觉证据。每一步解码时，SIRA 对比标准分支和反事实分支的 logits：如果某个 token 在反事实分支中仍然很强，说明它更可能来自语言先验或通用文本续写；如果它主要在标准分支中更强，则更可能由视觉证据支持。相比输入侧 blur/mask 这类外部扰动，SIRA 避免了 off-manifold artifact，也减少了第二次完整 multimodal forward 的开销。
summary.experiments: 论文在 POPE、CHAIR、AMBER 上评估，并覆盖 Qwen2.5-VL 与 LLaVA-v1.5。给定内容中没有列出完整表格数字，但作者报告 SIRA 能稳定降低 hallucination，同时保持描述覆盖度，并且推理开销低于两次完整前向的 contrastive decoding。实验重点不在训练增益，而在 decoding-time 的 hallucination/coverage/latency 取舍。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看方法部分的 shared-prefix late branching、post-boundary image-token masking，以及 split boundary 的选择逻辑。实验部分主要看 POPE、CHAIR、AMBER 的结果和效率对比；如果有消融，优先看不同分支层位置对 hallucination 和覆盖度的影响。对基座预训练研究而言，不必细读 benchmark 细节，重点关注它对多模态层间信息流的诊断价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses hallucination mitigation in large vision-language models during decoding. Its central question is whether contrastive decoding needs an externally perturbed image or an auxiliary reference, or whether a useful counterfactual can be built inside the same LVLM.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an inference-time decoding paper, not a pretraining paper. Its useful signal for foundation-model research is the view of multimodal information flow. Early layers may establish an aligned image-conditioned state, while later layers continue to use image tokens for fine-grained token decisions. A counterfactual reference that removes visual evidence at the input can break this alignment; a late internal branch that masks image access after early grounding may provide a cleaner estimate of language-prior-driven continuation.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIRA builds two synchronized branches inside one LVLM. The full branch performs standard multimodal decoding. The counterfactual branch shares the prompt, parameters, decoding history, positional structure, and early-layer computation with the full branch. After a chosen split boundary, the counterfactual branch is prevented from attending to image-token positions. At each decoding step, the method contrasts the logits from the full branch and the internal counterfactual branch. Tokens that remain strong without post-boundary visual access are treated as more likely driven by language priors; tokens whose advantage appears mainly in the full branch are favored as visually grounded. This avoids input-space perturbations such as blurring or masking, and it is cheaper than running a second full multimodal forward pass.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers POPE, CHAIR, and AMBER on Qwen2.5-VL and LLaVA-v1.5. The provided text does not include full numeric tables, but it reports consistent hallucination reduction while preserving descriptive coverage, with lower overhead than two-pass contrastive decoding. The main empirical tradeoff is not model training quality but decoding-time control: hallucination reduction, coverage retention, and added latency.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim of 20 to 30 minutes is enough. Focus on the shared-prefix late-branching design, the post-boundary image-token mask, and how the split layer is selected. In the experiments, prioritize the hallucination metrics on POPE, CHAIR, and AMBER, plus any ablation over branch depth. For pretraining researchers, the benchmark details are less important than the diagnostic implication: multimodal grounding and later visual access can be separated and probed within a single transformer.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain，但对“视觉信息究竟在哪几层起作用”给了更干净的解码探针；先看方法图和消融，若后层分叉成本真低，值得迁到内部 attribution 分析。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it gives a cleaner probe of where visual evidence actually matters across layers; read the method figure and ablations first, and steal it for internal attribution analysis if the late-branch cost is truly small.

paper.title: MHSA: A Lightweight Framework for Mitigating Hallucinations via Steered Attention in LVLMs
paper.abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across diverse multimodal tasks, yet they continue to suffer from hallucinations, generating content that is inconsistent with the visual input. Prior work DHCP (Detecting Hallucinations by Cross-modal Attention Pattern) has explored hallucination detection from the perspective of cross-modal attention, but does not address hallucination mitigation. In this paper, we propose MHSA (Mitigating Hallucinations via Steered Atte

summary.core_problem: 大视觉语言模型（LVLM）的幻觉问题——生成内容与输入视觉信息不一致，现有缓解方法存在明显局限：训练类方法需要大量算力和标注数据，推理类方法依赖固定的人工规则，无法适配每个样本的具体幻觉特征；此前基于交叉注意力模式的幻觉检测方法DHCP仅能完成检测任务，无法直接缓解幻觉，且仅支持句子级别的检测。
summary.importance: 为LVLM幻觉缓解提供了一种无需修改主干模型参数的轻量化方案，验证了通过数据驱动的注意力模式修正来缓解幻觉的可行性，且方案可迁移到不同的LVLM架构，具有较好的实用性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MHSA框架，核心是训练一个三层MLP生成器，输入原始交叉注意力矩阵，输出修正项，得到修正后的注意力矩阵；将预训练的DHCP检测器改造为token级别的判别器，提供注意力引导的监督信号，同时加入正则项保留原始注意力的基础结构，避免破坏输出质量；训练过程仅更新生成器和DHCP的参数，推理时替换LVLM的原始交叉注意力即可生效，无需修改LVLM主干；进一步将DHCP的检测能力扩展到token级别，支持生成类任务的幻觉缓解。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL2-8B、LLaVA-v1.5三个主流LVLM上进行测试，在判别类视觉问答任务上实现了稳定可靠的幻觉缓解效果，在生成类图像描述任务上也展现出缓解幻觉的潜力，通过注意力可视化验证了注意力修正与幻觉缓解的因果关联。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章方法部分，理解注意力修正模块的训练目标设计和token级别扩展的实现逻辑；查看实验部分的注意力可视化图表，直观感受修正前后的注意力模式变化；预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) suffer from hallucinations, where generated content is inconsistent with input visual information. Existing mitigation methods have limitations: training-based methods require massive computing resources and annotated data, while inference-time methods rely on fixed handcrafted rules that cannot adapt to sample-specific hallucination signatures. The prior DHCP method can only detect hallucinations via cross-modal attention patterns and cannot mitigate them, with detection limited to the sentence level.
summary_en.importance: It provides a lightweight hallucination mitigation solution for LVLMs that does not require modifying backbone model parameters, validates the feasibility of mitigating hallucinations through data-driven attention pattern correction, and is compatible with multiple LVLM architectures for practical deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The MHSA framework trains a 3-layer MLP generator that takes original cross-modal attention matrices as input and outputs correction terms to produce adjusted attention matrices. The pretrained DHCP detector is repurposed as a token-level discriminator to provide attention-guided supervision signals, with additional regularization to preserve the original attention structure and avoid degrading output quality. Only the generator and DHCP parameters are updated during training, and the corrected attention replaces the original cross-modal attention during inference without modifying the LVLM backbone. DHCP's detection capability is further extended to the token level to support hallucination mitigation for generative tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Tests are conducted on three mainstream LVLMs: Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL2-8B, and LLaVA-v1.5. Stable and reliable hallucination mitigation is achieved on discriminative visual question answering tasks, and the method also shows potential for hallucination reduction on generative image captioning tasks. Attention visualizations validate the causal link between attention correction and hallucination mitigation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 (Method) to understand the design of the attention correction module's training objectives and the implementation of token-level extension. Review the attention visualization charts in the experiments section to observe attention pattern changes before and after correction. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 利用内部注意力信号做轻量推理-time修正的思路有启发性，对多模态对齐研究有参考价值。看方法部分（§3）即可，实验验证强度一般。
recommendation.en: The inference-time attention steering approach using internal signals is conceptually interesting for multimodal alignment research. Read §3 (method) only; experimental validation is moderate.

paper.title: To See is Not to Learn: Protecting Multimodal Data from Unauthorized Fine-Tuning of Large Vision-Language Model
paper.abstract: The rapid advancement of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) is increasingly accompanied by unauthorized scraping and training on multimodal web data, posing severe copyright and privacy risks to data owners. Existing countermeasures, such as machine unlearning and watermarks, are inherent post-hoc approaches that act only after intellectual property infringement has already occurred. In this work, we propose MMGuard to empower data owners to proactively protect their multimodal data against un

summary.core_problem: 数据拥有者如何在图文数据被抓取前主动防止其被用于 LVLM 未授权微调。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态训练数据保护方法，关注版权和隐私场景下的 fine-tuning 数据可学习性；对基座预训练方法本身帮助有限，但能提供关于 VLM 学习动态和数据污染防御的边缘信号。
summary.technical_approach: MMGuard 生成对人不可察觉的扰动，把样本变成 unlearnable examples；扰动通过最小化训练损失制造优化捷径，让模型在微调时过拟合噪声，而推理时缺少该噪声会导致性能下降；还加入 cross-modal binding disruption，削弱图像与文本之间的绑定关系。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明针对 LVLM 未授权 fine-tuning 做防御评估，未给出具体模型、数据集、扰动预算、下游任务降幅或与 watermark、unlearning 等方法的量化比较。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how data owners can proactively protect image-text data from being scraped and used for unauthorized LVLM fine-tuning.
summary_en.importance: It contributes a multimodal data-protection method for copyright and privacy settings. It is only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining, but it may provide useful signals about LVLM learning dynamics and data-level defenses.
summary_en.technical_approach: MMGuard creates human-imperceptible perturbations that turn samples into unlearnable examples. The perturbation minimizes training loss to create an optimization shortcut, causing the model to overfit to noise that is absent at inference. It also disrupts cross-modal bindings between image and text.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that the method is evaluated against unauthorized LVLM fine-tuning, but does not specify the LVLMs, datasets, perturbation budgets, downstream degradation, or quantitative comparisons to watermarking and unlearning.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLM 数据防护方向扫一眼即可；机制依赖过拟合噪声，若无强自适应攻击实验，结论外推很有限。
recommendation.en: Worth a glance as VLM data defense; the mechanism leans on noise overfitting, so without strong adaptive attacks the claims should not be extrapolated.

paper.title: Large Vision-Language Models Get Lost in Attention
paper.abstract: Despite the rapid evolution of training paradigms, the decoder backbone of large vision--language models (LVLMs) remains fundamentally rooted in the residual-connection Transformer architecture. Therefore, deciphering the distinct roles of internal modules is critical for understanding model mechanics and guiding architectural optimization. While prior statistical approaches have provided valuable attribution-based insights, they often lack a unified theoretical basis. To bridge this gap, we pro

summary.core_problem: 在 LVLM 解码器里，attention 与 FFN 通过残差流共同更新表示，但现有分析多是统计归因，缺少统一的、可比较的度量来回答：两类模块到底在“改变表示的什么性质”，以及视觉 token 的注意力交互是否真的在注入有效信息。论文要解决的是：用信息论+几何的统一框架刻画残差更新的“创新(information injection)”与“重配置(entropic reconfiguration)”，并据此诊断 LVLM 的视觉注意力低效问题。
summary.importance: 这更偏机制分析/架构诊断，而不是直接的预训练方法改进。但它给了两个可复用的度量（RID、MixIG）来量化残差更新对表示子空间与信息混合的影响，能用于：比较不同 LVLM 架构、定位视觉 token 融合的瓶颈、以及为后续的架构改造（例如减少无效 cross-attn 计算、调整模块配比）提供证据。对做预训练的人，价值在于把“attention 负责推理、FFN 负责记忆”这类经验说法，变成可测量的几何/熵分解，并指出视觉侧存在系统性冗余。
summary.technical_approach:
论文基于 manifold hypothesis，把残差流表示看作落在某个低维语义流形附近，并把每个子模块产生的残差更新 Δ 写成对表示分布/子空间的几何作用。提出两类指标：
- Representation Information Discrepancy (RID)：用于衡量更新带来的“创新”，即是否引入新的语义方向/扩展表示支持（可理解为对子空间谱结构、复杂度的外延扩张）。
- Mixing Information Gain (MixIG)：用于衡量“重配置”，即在既有支持内对信息进行重新分配/混合的程度（更偏熵意义上的重排，而非新增方向）。
用这套分解去比较 attention update 与 FFN update，得到定量结论：attention 更像子空间保持的算子，主要做 reconfiguration；FFN 更主导 innovation。然后把框架用于 LVLM 的视觉-文本交互，发现 decoder 的视觉 attention 往往没有对问题相关视觉证据做有效 mixing，而是出现高冗余、低信息增益的交互模式（论文用“get lost in attention”概括）。
summary.experiments: 作者在 15 个 LVLM 上做了系统测量，覆盖三类主流架构，并在多模态 benchmark 上评估模块更新的 RID/MixIG 分布与层间变化。核心经验结论是：attention 的贡献主要体现在 MixIG（重配置）而非 RID（创新），FFN 相反；并且在视觉相关的 cross-attention/decoder attention 中，MixIG 也常表现为“低有效混合/高冗余”，说明大量计算没有转化为信息性的表示更新。摘要未给出具体数值；全文的关键在于指标定义、跨模型一致性、以及对视觉注意力冗余的定量证据（例如不同层/不同 token 类型的 RID/MixIG 曲线与对照）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
1) 先读指标定义部分：RID 与 MixIG 的形式化、它们分别对应“创新/重配置”的直觉，以及如何在实际模型激活上估计。
2) 直接跳到“attention vs FFN 分工”的主结果图：看不同模型/不同层是否一致，避免只被个例驱动。
3) 再看“视觉注意力低效”的诊断实验：重点是他们如何定义“问题相关视觉证据”、如何量化冗余，以及是否做了对照（例如文本-only attention、不同视觉 tokenization）。
4) 若时间有限，优先看方法图+两三张主结果图即可；如果要复现/迁移到自家模型，再补实现细节与统计稳健性（不同 prompt、不同任务、不同输入长度下的方差）。

summary_en.core_problem: In LVLM decoders, attention and FFN both write into the same residual stream, yet existing attribution-style analyses lack a unified, theoretically grounded way to compare what each module actually does to representations—especially for visual-token integration. The paper aims to formalize residual updates in terms of (a) injecting new information/semantic directions vs (b) rearranging/mixing existing information, and then use that lens to diagnose why visual attention often underutilizes relevant evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily interpretability and architectural diagnosis rather than a new pretraining recipe. Its practical value is providing reusable metrics (RID, MixIG) to quantify residual-update effects across models and layers, enabling more principled comparisons of LVLM designs and evidence for where visual-token computation is informationally sparse. For pretraining researchers, it turns the informal “attention = reasoning, FFN = memory” narrative into measurable geometric/entropic decompositions and highlights systematic redundancy in visual attention pathways.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Assuming a manifold view of representation space, the paper treats each submodule’s residual update Δ as a geometric operator acting on the residual stream. It introduces:
- Representation Information Discrepancy (RID) to capture “innovation”: whether the update expands the representational support / introduces new semantic directions (often discussed via spectral/subspace changes).
- Mixing Information Gain (MixIG) to capture “reconfiguration”: entropic redistribution and mixing within the existing support, without adding new directions.
Applying these metrics to attention vs FFN updates yields a consistent functional decoupling: attention behaves largely as a subspace-preserving reconfiguration operator, while FFNs dominate innovation. The same framework is then applied to multimodal attention patterns, arguing that decoder visual attention frequently performs redundant interactions with limited informative mixing—hence “getting lost in attention.”
summary_en.experiments: The study reports extensive measurements across 15 LVLMs spanning three major architecture families and multiple multimodal benchmarks. The headline empirical pattern is that attention updates score primarily on MixIG (reconfiguration) rather than RID (innovation), with FFNs showing the opposite trend. For visual-token processing, the metrics indicate substantial redundancy and weak effective mixing over question-relevant visual evidence. The abstract does not expose key numbers; the full paper’s evidence hinges on the consistency of RID/MixIG trends across models/layers and the quantitative diagnostics isolating visual-attention inefficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the metric definitions carefully (RID/MixIG) and how they are estimated from activations; this determines whether you can reuse them.
- Jump to the main plots comparing attention vs FFN across depth and across models; check for consistency rather than single-model anecdotes.
- Then read the section diagnosing visual attention: how “relevant visual evidence” is operationalized, what redundancy means quantitatively, and what controls are used.
- If you intend to apply it, follow up on implementation details and robustness checks (task/prompt/input-length variance).

recommendation.zh: 只看第3节功能解耦实验部分即可，注意力权重可替换的结论对Transformer架构精简有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Only read Section 3 for functional decoupling experiments, the conclusion that attention weights are replaceable provides reference for Transformer architecture simplification.

paper.title: CAST: Mitigating Object Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models via Caption-Guided Visual Attention Steering
paper.abstract: Although Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on downstream tasks, they frequently produce contents that deviate from visual information, leading to object hallucination. To tackle this, recent works mostly depend on expensive manual annotations and training cost, or decoding strategies which significantly increase inference time. In this work, we observe that LVLMs' attention to visual information is significantly enhanced when answering caption queries

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM 在非图像描述类问题中对视觉证据利用不足、从而产生对象幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 LVLM 幻觉缓解和注意力机制分析。价值在于提出一个无需训练的 attention steering 视角：caption query 激活出的视觉注意模式可迁移到其他查询，作为低成本的视觉 grounding 增强信号。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CAST，先用 probing 找到对 caption query 高敏感的 attention heads，再估计这些 head 输出空间中的 steering directions；推理时把 caption-guided 的视觉注意激活模式注入到非 caption 查询中，增强模型对视觉 token 的关注。方法是 plug-and-play，不需要人工标注和额外训练，目标是避免显著增加推理时延。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出具体 LVLM、数据集、baseline 或数值结果。可确认的实验主线应包括对象幻觉评测、不同 query 类型下视觉注意差异分析、head probing 以及与训练式或解码式幻觉缓解方法的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets object hallucination in LVLMs, especially cases where non-caption queries underuse visual evidence.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free hallucination mitigation method plus an attention-level observation: caption queries elicit stronger visual attention, and that activation pattern can be reused as a grounding signal for other queries.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAST probes attention heads that are sensitive to caption queries and estimates steering directions in their output space. At inference time, it injects the caption-guided visual-attention pattern into non-caption queries to increase reliance on visual tokens. The method is plug-and-play and avoids supervised retraining or heavy decoding-time search.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, datasets, baselines, or quantitative results. The likely evaluation includes object-hallucination benchmarks, attention analysis across query types, head probing, and comparisons against training-based or decoding-based mitigation methods.

recommendation.zh: 只看 attention head probing 和消融即可；训练无关但能检验 LVLM 幻觉是否来自 query-conditioned grounding 缺口。
recommendation.en: Read only the head-probing and ablation parts; it is not a pretraining method, but it tests whether LVLM hallucination is partly a query-conditioned grounding gap.

paper.title: Before Forgetting, Learn to Remember: Revisiting Foundational Learning Failures in LVLM Unlearning Benchmarks
paper.abstract: While Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) offer powerful capabilities, they pose privacy risks by unintentionally memorizing sensitive personal information. Current unlearning benchmarks attempt to mitigate this using fictitious identities but overlook a critical stage 1 failure: models fail to effectively memorize target information initially, rendering subsequent unlearning evaluations unreliable. Diagnosing under-memorization and the multi-hop curse as root causes, we introduce ReMem, a Reli

summary.core_problem: 解决 LVLM unlearning benchmark 在评估遗忘前没有确认模型是否真正记住目标信息，导致遗忘效果评估不可靠的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态模型记忆与遗忘评测工作，贡献在于指出现有 benchmark 的阶段性失败：模型常常没有充分学习虚构身份信息，却被拿来评估 unlearning；同时提出更可靠的多图、多跳记忆 benchmark 和 Exposure 指标。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReMem benchmark，通过数据规模控制、面向推理的 QA 构造、多样视觉上下文来强化基础记忆阶段；同时提出 Exposure 指标，用模型内部概率分布衡量信息擦除深度，而不只看表面回答是否改变。
summary.experiments: 对多个 LVLM 进行学习与 unlearning 诊断，重点验证 under-memorization 和 multi-hop curse 是现有评测失真的根因；摘要未列出具体模型名称、参数规模、数据量和数值提升，需要正文确认。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Chung-Ang University 和 KT Corporation；从给定信息无法确认有知名基础模型团队或代表性大模型工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an evaluation flaw in LVLM unlearning benchmarks: models may not have memorized the target information before unlearning is measured.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark and analysis contribution for multimodal memorization and unlearning. Its main value is identifying a stage-one failure in current fictitious-identity unlearning setups and proposing a more reliable multi-image, multi-hop memorization benchmark plus an Exposure metric.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReMem enforces a stronger learning stage through principled data scaling, reasoning-aware QA pairs, and diverse visual contexts. The proposed Exposure metric measures the depth of erasure in the model’s probability distribution rather than only checking whether surface answers change.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates LVLM learning and unlearning behavior, diagnosing under-memorization and the multi-hop curse as key sources of unreliable evaluation. The abstract does not specify exact model sizes, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Chung-Ang University and KT Corporation. The provided metadata does not establish a known foundation-model lab or prior flagship model work.

recommendation.zh: 只看 benchmark 构造和 Exposure 指标即可；它提醒 unlearning 评测先验不干净，但还不到改变训练方法的程度。
recommendation.en: Read only the benchmark design and Exposure metric; it exposes a dirty unlearning-eval assumption, but does not yet change training practice.

paper.title: Perceptual Flow Network for Visually Grounded Reasoning
paper.abstract: Despite the success of Large-Vision Language Models (LVLMs), general optimization objectives (e.g., standard MLE) fail to constrain visual trajectories, leading to language bias and hallucination. To mitigate this, current methods introduce geometric priors from visual experts as additional supervision. However, we observe that such supervision is typically suboptimal: it is biased toward geometric precision and offers limited reasoning utility. To bridge this gap, we propose Perceptual Flow Net

summary.core_problem: LVLM 在视觉推理时，直接对齐视觉专家（如 GroundingDINO）的几何先验（如精确的边界框）会导致“管中窥豹”效应，反而限制了推理能力并引发幻觉。
summary.importance: 揭示了视觉定位（Grounding）与视觉推理（Reasoning）在目标上的错位，提出了一种解耦感知与推理的自条件生成范式，为 VLM 的 RL 微调提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PFlowNet。核心是不再强制模型严格对齐静态的几何先验，而是：1) 将感知行为建模为结构化的“感知流”（Perceptual Flow，即 RoI 序列）；2) 解耦感知与推理，模型先采样内在分布生成感知轨迹，再基于此进行自回归推理；3) 采用变分强化微调（Variational RL Fine-Tuning），结合多维奖励和邻域几何塑形（vicinal geometric shaping），优化感知轨迹。
summary.experiments: 在 V* Bench、TreeBench 和 MME-RealWorld-lite 上，基于 Qwen2.5-VL 8B，分别取得了 13.1%、10.4% 和 21% 的显著提升，证明了该方法在细粒度视觉任务中的有效性。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中的 Preliminary Study（图1），理解为什么精确的几何先验不适合推理。其次看 Method 中如何将感知轨迹形式化为隐变量，以及变分强化微调的目标函数设计。

summary_en.core_problem: In LVLMs, directly aligning with geometric priors from visual experts (e.g., precise bounding boxes from GroundingDINO) causes a 'tunnel vision' effect, which limits reasoning capabilities and induces hallucinations.
summary_en.importance: Reveals the misalignment between visual grounding and visual reasoning objectives. Proposes a self-conditioned generation paradigm that decouples perception and reasoning, offering a novel perspective for RL fine-tuning in VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PFlowNet. Instead of forcing rigid alignment with static geometric priors, it: 1) models perceptual behavior as a structured 'Perceptual Flow' (a sequence of RoIs); 2) decouples perception from reasoning, where the model first samples an intrinsic distribution to generate a perceptual trajectory, then performs self-conditioned autoregressive reasoning; 3) employs Variational Reinforcement Fine-Tuning with multi-dimensional rewards and vicinal geometric shaping to optimize the trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: Based on Qwen2.5-VL 8B, it achieves significant improvements of 13.1%, 10.4%, and 21% on V* Bench, TreeBench, and MME-RealWorld-lite, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness in fine-grained visual tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Preliminary Study in the Introduction (Figure 1) to understand why precise geometric priors are suboptimal for reasoning. Then, examine the Method section to see how perceptual trajectories are formalized as latent variables and how the variational RL fine-tuning objective is designed.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和实验表：它质疑几何专家监督的默认收益，但需看 reward 设计是否泄漏任务偏好。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main tables: it challenges the default value of geometric expert supervision, but the reward design may encode task-specific bias.

paper.title: Make Your LVLM KV Cache More Lightweight
paper.abstract: Key-Value (KV) cache has become a de facto component of modern Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) for inference. While it enhances decoding efficiency in Large Language Models (LLMs), its direct adoption in LVLMs introduces substantial GPU memory overhead due to the large number of vision tokens processed during the prefill stage. To tackle this problem, we propose LightKV, a novel approach that reduces KV cache size by exploiting the redundancy among vision-token embeddings. Guided by text pr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 LVLM 推理阶段一个很具体但很实际的问题：视觉 token 在 prefill 阶段数量过大，导致 KV cache 显存占用远高于纯文本 LLM，而现有 KV 压缩方法大多在生成阶段做 token 剪枝，或者只看视觉侧冗余，没有充分利用文本提示对“哪些视觉 token 重要”的指导。LightKV 的目标是在不重训模型的前提下，于 prefill 阶段直接压缩视觉 token 对应的 KV cache，同时尽量不损伤多模态理解性能。
summary.importance: 它不属于预训练方法，而是典型的 efficient 类工作。但对基座研究仍有两点启发。第一，LVLM 的系统瓶颈和 LLM 不同，prefill 阶段的视觉 token 爆炸是核心问题，说明统一多模态建模时 tokenization 设计会直接决定部署成本。第二，作者证明“文本提示引导的视觉压缩”优于纯视觉压缩，这说明跨模态注意力不仅是建模工具，也可以作为推理时的信息选择信号。对做视觉 tokenizer、长上下文多模态建模、训练时 token budget 设计的人，这个观察是有价值的。
summary.technical_approach: LightKV 是一个 training-free 的 prefill 压缩方法，核心思想是：不要把所有视觉 token 原样写入后续层的 KV cache，而是在 prefill 过程中先做一次受文本提示引导的聚合压缩。方法分三步。1）把视觉 token 看成图节点，节点间边权由 feature divergence 度量，用来判断哪些 token 信息相近、可以聚合。这里的目标不是简单删 token，而是把冗余 token 的信息合并到更有代表性的 token 上。2）为了避免两两计算 divergence 带来的高复杂度，作者按原始空间位置把视觉 token 划分为多个 sub-windows，在局部窗口内做压缩与消息聚合。这样复杂度更可控，也更符合视觉 patch 的局部相关性。3）最关键的是引入文本提示引导。作者不采用纯视觉独立压缩，而是利用运行时 cross-modal attention 分数，让文本 token 对视觉 token 的重要性评估参与更新过程。直觉上，用户问题决定了哪些图像区域值得保留，因此 prompt-aware 压缩比 vision-only 压缩更合理。论文还强调该方法可兼容 vision encoder-based 和 encoder-free 的 LVLM，不需要改模型参数，也不需要额外训练。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 8 个开源 LVLM 和 8 个 benchmark，模型包括 LLaVA-v1.5 7B/13B、LLaVA-NeXT 7B/13B、InternVL2-8B、EVE-7B-v1、EVE-7B-v1-HD、Qwen2.5-VL。作者报告的主结果是：视觉 token 的 KV memory 可减少 50%，同时整体性能基本保持，有些 benchmark 甚至超过原始模型；在相同 token 长度生成预算下，FLOPs 降低约 40%。从论文叙述看，prompt-aware 设计优于现有 vision-only 压缩基线，这是方法成立的关键证据。另一个重要点是它把压缩时机前移到 prefill，而不是等 KV 已经写满后再做裁剪，因此对显存峰值更直接有效。全文片段没有给出逐 benchmark 的具体分数和不同压缩率下的退化曲线，但从作者总结可确认：方法在多种架构上都有可迁移性，且不是依赖某一个模型的特例。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 里对问题的界定，尤其是为什么 LVLM 的 KV cache 问题比 LLM 更严重：异构 token 和超长视觉前缀。然后直接看方法部分的三步设计，重点不是图建模细节本身，而是为什么要用 prompt-aware cross-modal attention 来指导压缩。接着看主表，确认 50% KV 压缩和性能保持是否在不同模型上都成立；再看消融，比较 vision-only 与 prompt-guided 的差异，以及 sub-window 划分对效率和效果的影响。如果只想判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟足够；如果要复现，需额外关注它插入压缩的位置、对不同层是否统一处理、以及压缩后 KV 的重排方式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical inference bottleneck in LVLMs: vision tokens dominate the prefill stage, so the KV cache consumes far more GPU memory than in text-only LLMs. Existing KV reduction methods mostly prune after prefill or rely on vision-only redundancy signals, which is suboptimal because the user prompt already tells the model which visual content matters. LightKV aims to compress the vision-side KV cache during prefill, without retraining, while preserving multimodal performance.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it still carries two useful lessons for foundation-model work. First, the systems bottleneck in LVLMs is structurally different from that in LLMs: the visual prefix explosion during prefill is often the dominant memory issue. That makes tokenization and token budget design a first-order modeling choice, not just a serving detail. Second, the paper shows that text-guided visual compression works better than vision-only compression, suggesting that cross-modal attention is not only a modeling mechanism but also a useful runtime signal for information selection. That matters for multimodal tokenizers, long-context multimodal modeling, and training-time allocation of visual tokens.
summary_en.technical_approach: LightKV is a training-free prefill-time compression method. The central idea is to avoid writing all vision tokens into the downstream KV cache as-is; instead, it aggregates and compresses them during prefill under prompt guidance. The method has three steps. (1) Vision tokens are treated as graph nodes, and edges are defined by a feature divergence metric that estimates redundancy. The goal is not naive token dropping, but information aggregation from redundant tokens into more representative ones. (2) To avoid the quadratic cost of pairwise divergence over many vision tokens, the method partitions tokens into spatial sub-windows and performs local compression and message passing inside them. This reduces complexity and matches the locality of visual patches. (3) The key design is prompt-aware guidance. Rather than compressing vision tokens independently, LightKV uses on-the-fly cross-modal attention scores between text tokens and vision tokens to decide which visual content should be preserved. This is a sensible choice because the prompt determines relevance. The method is designed to be plug-and-play across both vision-encoder-based and encoder-free LVLMs, with no parameter updates.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers eight open-source LVLMs and eight benchmarks, including LLaVA-v1.5 7B/13B, LLaVA-NeXT 7B/13B, InternVL2-8B, EVE-7B-v1, EVE-7B-v1-HD, and Qwen2.5-VL. The headline result is that LightKV reduces the KV memory of vision tokens by 50% while largely preserving performance, and in some cases even improving over the vanilla model. Under the same generation token budget, it also reduces FLOPs by about 40%. The most important empirical claim is that prompt-aware compression outperforms prior vision-only baselines, which is the main evidence that cross-modal guidance is doing real work. Another important point is that compression happens during prefill rather than after the cache is already populated, so it directly lowers peak memory. The excerpt does not provide enough table detail to restate benchmark-by-benchmark numbers or degradation curves at different compression ratios, but the paper clearly presents the method as architecture-agnostic rather than tuned to one specific LVLM.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the problem framing in the introduction, especially why KV cache is a more severe issue in LVLMs than in LLMs: heterogeneous tokens and very long visual prefixes. Then go straight to the three-step method and focus less on the graph formalism itself and more on why prompt-aware cross-modal attention is the right compression signal. After that, inspect the main results table to verify whether the 50% KV reduction holds consistently across model families, and then read the ablations comparing vision-only versus prompt-guided compression, as well as the effect of sub-window partitioning on efficiency and accuracy. If the goal is only to assess relevance, 30 minutes is enough. If the goal is reproduction, pay attention to where compression is inserted, whether all layers are treated the same way, and how the compressed KV entries are reordered or merged.

recommendation.zh: 只看压缩位置和消融表即可；prompt-aware token 压缩是合理工程线索，但不改变预训练侧判断。
recommendation.en: Read only the compression-placement and ablation tables; prompt-aware token compression is a useful serving clue, not a pretraining prior shift.

paper.title: Persistent Visual Memory: Sustaining Perception for Deep Generation in LVLMs
paper.abstract: While autoregressive Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate remarkable proficiency in multimodal tasks, they face a "Visual Signal Dilution" phenomenon, where the accumulation of textual history expands the attention partition function, causing visual attention to decay inversely with generated sequence length. To counteract this, we propose Persistent Visual Memory (PVM), a lightweight learnable module designed to ensure sustained, on-demand visual perception. Integrated as a parallel

summary.core_problem: PVM 解决的是 LVLM 长生成过程中视觉 token 注意力被不断增长的文本历史稀释，导致模型后段生成更依赖语言先验、较难持续读取原始视觉证据的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于核心预训练方法，但对 MLLM 架构设计有参考价值。它把长上下文 LVLM 的一个常见现象写成了清晰的机制假设：视觉 token 是一次性注入的固定前缀，文本 token 会随生成不断增长，softmax attention 的分母随上下文变大后，视觉注意力质量会下降。这个分析对设计 native multimodal backbone、视觉 memory、长链推理中的 grounding 机制都有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是在 Transformer block 的 FFN 旁边增加一个轻量并行分支 Persistent Visual Memory。原 FFN 继续承载语言生成和推理状态，PVM 分支通过 gated cross-attention 专门访问原始视觉 embedding。这样视觉信息不再只依赖自注意力里离当前位置很远的前缀 token，而是有一条与生成距离无关的检索通道。论文先把 attention softmax 分母拆成视觉部分和文本历史部分，说明文本历史长度增加会降低视觉 token 的相对概率质量；随后用并行视觉检索分支缓解这一结构性衰减。与直接重新插入视觉 token 的方法相比，PVM 避免频繁扰动主生成序列的隐状态，试图在视觉 grounding 和语言连贯性之间做更稳的分工。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3-VL 系列，在 8 个多模态 benchmark 上评估 general understanding 和 scientific reasoning。论文报告 8B 版本加入 PVM 后平均准确率提升 4.8%，4B 版本提升 4.4%。作者还做了长生成场景下的视觉信号衰减分析，显示 PVM 对长度诱发的视觉注意力下降更稳。LogitLens 分析用于检查内部预测动态，结论是 PVM 加速了模型对正确答案的内部收敛，而不只是因为增加了一点参数量。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。优先看第 3 节的 Visual Signal Dilution 推导，判断假设是否依赖过强的 attention 分布简化；再看 PVM 模块结构图和 gated cross-attention 的插入位置；最后看 4B/8B 的消融表、长生成长度分桶结果和 LogitLens 分析。若关注 MLLM 预训练架构，可以重点思考 PVM 是否应该只在 post-training 阶段插入，还是应在视觉语言预训练阶段一起训练。

summary_en.core_problem: PVM addresses visual signal dilution in autoregressive LVLMs: as the generated text history grows, attention to the fixed visual prefix weakens, so later tokens rely more on language priors and less on the original image evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is useful for multimodal model architecture. It gives a concrete mechanism for a common long-generation failure mode in LVLMs. Visual tokens are injected once, while text tokens keep accumulating. The softmax attention denominator grows with the textual context, which can reduce the relative attention mass assigned to visual evidence. This framing is relevant for native multimodal pretraining, persistent memory design, and grounded long-chain reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method adds a lightweight Persistent Visual Memory branch in parallel with the FFN inside Transformer blocks. The original FFN path preserves the main autoregressive reasoning state. The PVM branch uses gated cross-attention to retrieve from the original visual embeddings directly. This creates a distance-agnostic visual retrieval path, rather than relying only on self-attention to far-away visual prefix tokens. The paper first decomposes the attention partition function into visual mass and textual-history mass, then argues that the latter grows with generation length and suppresses visual attention. Compared with methods that repeatedly inject visual tokens into the main sequence, PVM is less invasive: it strengthens access to visual evidence without constantly perturbing the serial language-generation state.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are built on the Qwen3-VL family and cover eight multimodal benchmarks, including general understanding and scientific reasoning. The reported average accuracy gain is 4.8% for the 8B model and 4.4% for the 4B model. The paper also evaluates extended-generation settings and shows improved robustness against length-induced visual decay. A LogitLens analysis suggests that PVM helps internal predictions converge earlier, rather than merely benefiting from a small increase in parameter count.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is enough. Start with the Visual Signal Dilution derivation and check how strong the assumptions are about attention score distributions. Then read the module design: where the PVM branch is inserted, how gated cross-attention is parameterized, and whether visual embeddings are frozen or updated. Finally inspect the 4B/8B ablations, length-bucket results, and LogitLens plots. For pretraining-oriented readers, the main question is whether this kind of persistent visual retrieval should be added only during post-training, or trained from the vision-language pretraining stage.

recommendation.zh: 看视觉 attention 随长度衰减的证据；模块本身未必通用，但这个 failure mode 值得纳入 LVLM 评测。
recommendation.en: Inspect the evidence for length-driven visual-attention decay; the module may not generalize, but the failure mode should enter LVLM evals.

paper.title: Prefill-Time Intervention for Mitigating Hallucination in Large Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in visual-textual understanding, yet their reliability is critically undermined by hallucinations, i.e., the generation of factually incorrect or inconsistent responses. While recent studies using steering vectors demonstrated promise in reducing hallucinations, a notable challenge remains: they inadvertently amplify the severity of residual hallucinations. summary.core_problem: LVLM 幻觉缓解里，为什么很多 decoding-time steering（DTI）虽然降低幻觉频率，却会让剩余幻觉更“严重”、更容易滚雪球；以及能否在不改参数的前提下，从源头阻断这种自回归误差累积。论文把关键矛盾定位在干预时机与对象：在 decoding 阶段持续加 steering，往往是在错误表征已经形成后被动补救，且对多模态对齐与细粒度视觉证据不够敏感。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线的相关性偏低到中等：它是推理期的可插拔干预方法，不涉及预训练目标/数据/优化。但它对“训练动态/表征”有一个可迁移的观点：KV cache 不是被动缓存，而是决定后续生成轨迹的初始状态；如果幻觉来自早期多模态表征偏置，那么在 prefill 阶段一次性把注意力的 key/value 分布拉回到更 grounded 的区域，可能比 decoding 阶段反复纠偏更稳定。这类思路也可能反哺到训练侧（例如把 cache-level 约束做成训练正则或蒸馏目标）。

提出 Prefill-Time Intervention (PTI)：只在 prefill 阶段干预一次，直接修改初始 KV cache，而不是在 decoding 阶段对 hidden state 持续加 steering。
设计原则对应 DTI 的三类问题：
- when：从 reactive decoding 改为 proactive prefill，一次性塑形初始状态，减少后续自回归误差累积。
- how：modality-aware，区分视觉与文本的敏感性，不用“只从文本态导出的统一 steering 向量”。
- what：从粗粒度 hidden state 转向细粒度 KV cache，直接作用于注意力机制；并利用 K（决定 attend 到哪里）与 V（决定聚合什么信息）的角色差异做解耦控制。

summary.experiments: 在三种架构不同的 LVLM 上验证：LLaVA-1.5、Qwen-VL-Chat、DeepSeek-VL-Chat；在“object hallucination”与更综合的基准上优于既有 decoding-time 方法，并声称能缓解“降低频率但加重残余幻觉”的两难。当前给出的全文片段未包含具体基准名称、指标定义与数值表，也未展示与 VISTA 等方法的逐项对比数字、以及 PTI+DTI 叠加的增益幅度；需要在实验章节核对。

- 先看引言与方法开头对“snowball hallucination”成因的拆解：为什么持续 decoding steering 可能放大残余错误。

summary_en.core_problem: Decoding-time steering for hallucination mitigation in LVLMs often reduces hallucination frequency but worsens the severity of remaining errors via autoregressive “snowballing”. The paper asks whether a single, proactive intervention can prevent error accumulation at the source without changing model parameters.
summary_en.importance: Low-to-moderate relevance for pretraining-focused work: it is an inference-time, plug-and-play control method rather than a new pretraining recipe. The transferable insight is representation-centric: the prefill KV cache is an initial condition that shapes the entire generation trajectory. If hallucinations are seeded by early multimodal misalignment, intervening once at cache construction can be more stable than repeatedly correcting during decoding. This could inspire training-side objectives (e.g., cache-level regularization/distillation), though the paper itself stays at inference.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Prefill-Time Intervention (PTI): intervene only once during prefill by directly modifying the initial KV cache, instead of applying a uniform steering vector to hidden states throughout decoding.
It is designed around three axes:
- When: proactive prefill intervention to stop error accumulation before it starts.
- How: modality-aware steering, avoiding text-only, modality-agnostic directions.
- What: target fine-grained KV cache rather than coarse hidden states; exploit the functional split between keys (where to attend) and values (what content to aggregate).
Concretely, PTI derives steering directions using object-vs-background contrasts: steer keys toward object-grounded attention and steer values to suppress background noise, producing a better-grounded cache for subsequent normal decoding. PTI is claimed to be orthogonal to existing decoding-time methods and can be combined with them.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three LVLMs with different architectures: LLaVA-1.5, Qwen-VL-Chat, and DeepSeek-VL-Chat. The paper reports improvements on object-hallucination and broader hallucination benchmarks, outperforming prior decoding-time interventions, and claims better control of residual hallucination severity. The provided excerpt does not include the exact benchmark names, metrics, or numeric tables, nor the magnitude of gains for PTI+DTI combinations; these need verification in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the motivation around “snowball hallucinations” and why continuous decoding-time steering can backfire.
- Focus on how PTI computes cache-level directions from multimodal signals and how K/V are modified (layers, token ranges, strength hyperparameters).
- Check the add-on experiments combining PTI with existing DTI methods; this determines whether PTI is a generally useful intervention point.
Time: ~15–25 minutes for the core idea; add ~30 minutes for implementation details if integrating into an inference stack.

paper.title: Structural Pruning of Large Vision Language Models: A Comprehensive Study on Pruning Dynamics, Recovery, and Data Efficiency
paper.abstract: While Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate impressive capabilities, their substantial computational and memory requirements pose deployment challenges on resource-constrained edge devices. Current parameter reduction techniques primarily involve training LVLMs from small language models, but these methods offer limited flexibility and remain computationally intensive. We study a complementary route: compressing existing LVLMs by applying structured pruning to the language model backb

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是如何从小语言模型重新训练一个轻量 LVLM，而是另一路径：能否直接对现有 LVLM 的语言骨干做结构化剪枝，再用较轻量的恢复训练把性能拉回来。核心问题有三层。第一，LVLM 上哪些结构化剪枝方式更合适：删整层，还是缩宽度。第二，剪枝后性能下降主要来自语言能力受损，还是视觉-语言对齐被破坏。第三，在恢复阶段，SFT、logit distillation、hidden-state distillation 以及数据规模之间，哪种组合最划算。
summary.importance: 对纯预训练研究的直接相关性有限，因为它主要是压缩与恢复训练研究，不是新的基座建模范式。但它对多模态基座的训练后阶段有实用启发，尤其是两个方面。其一，文章把 LVLM 剪枝后的退化拆成“alignment 先坏”还是“language backbone 也坏”，这对理解多模态模型的脆弱部位有帮助。其二，它给出一个比较系统的经验结论：轻中度压缩时，问题往往先出在 projector / multimodal alignment，而不是整个语言模型都失效；因此恢复训练不一定要全量重训。这对做多模态 continual pretrain、mid-train 压缩、边缘部署版本蒸馏的人有参考价值。贡献类型主要是系统性 empirical study，而不是新 pruning 算法。
summary.technical_approach:
作者选了三类代表性 LVLM：LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Bunny-v1-3B、Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B。共同点是都由 vision encoder、multimodal projector 和 language backbone 组成，因此可以把压缩重点放在参数占比最大的语言骨干上。文章研究两种结构化剪枝范式。

第一种是 layerwise pruning，直接删除整个 transformer blocks。它继承了 LLM 剪层工作的思路，假设部分层存在冗余。优点是结构简单，硬件友好；缺点是对表示路径的破坏比较粗暴，尤其可能伤到跨模态信息在深层的整合。

第二种是 widthwise pruning，缩减每层内部宽度，包括 attention heads 和 MLP neurons。它不是删掉整层计算路径，而是在保留层级深度的前提下压缩每层容量。作者把这一路径视为更细粒度的结构化压缩，因此理论上更有机会保住多模态对齐链路。

剪枝之后，作者比较多种恢复策略。基础恢复是 supervised finetuning。其上再叠加两类蒸馏：logit distillation 和 hidden-state distillation（L2）。从文章给出的结论看，hidden-state distillation 比只蒸 logits 更稳定，因为 LVLM 剪枝后的问题不只是输出分布偏了，还包括中间表示和视觉-语言对齐被扰动。作者还专门分析了低压缩比与高压缩比下的 degradation dynamics：低压缩时主要是 multimodal alignment 受损，因此只调 projector 就能恢复不少；高压缩时语言 backbone 本身也明显退化，这时必须做更充分的全模型恢复。

另一个值得注意的设计是数据效率分析。作者把 calibration dataset size 和 recovery training data size 都做了系统扫描，试图回答“要不要拿回原始大规模多模态数据重训”这个实际问题。文章给出的答案偏务实：校准数据可以很少，恢复训练也不一定需要全量原始数据。
summary.experiments:
从摘要和正文可确认的实验主线有几部分。

1）模型与评测范围。作者在三类 LVLM family 上做实验：LLaVA-v1.5-7B、Bunny-v1-3B、Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B。评测不只看通用 VQA，还加入了更能暴露推理与结构理解退化的 benchmark，如 AI2D、MathVista、DocVQA。这个设计是合理的，因为剪枝后最容易先掉的往往不是简单感知，而是需要长链路整合的复杂推理。

2）剪枝范式比较。文章的主结论是：在低资源恢复设定下，widthwise pruning 普遍优于 layerwise pruning。原因不是单纯“参数保留更多”，而是 layerwise 删除会更明显破坏深层推理路径与跨模态融合，因此在 reasoning-heavy benchmark 上掉点更严重。作者特别指出，layerwise pruning 对复杂推理任务的伤害大于 widthwise pruning，这一点比只看平均分更有解释力。

3）退化机理分析。作者把性能下降拆成 modality alignment degradation 与 language capability degradation。结论是：低压缩比时，主要损伤发生在视觉-语言对齐，语言骨干相对还在；高压缩比时，两者都会明显受损。这直接导出恢复策略差异：轻度压缩时，只微调 projector 就可能足够；压缩更激进时，必须连 language backbone 一起恢复。

4）恢复训练策略。作者验证了 SFT + hidden-state distillation（L2）是最稳的组合，优于单独 SFT，也优于只做 logits distillation。这个结果符合多模态模型的特点：输出 logits 只能约束最终 token 分布，但 hidden-state 蒸馏能更直接地拉回被剪枝扰乱的中间表示与对齐空间。

5）数据效率。文章给出的一个实用结论是，calibration 对数据量并不敏感，所需数据很少；恢复训练在只用原始训练数据 5% 的情况下，仍能取得有效结果。这个结论对部署侧很重要，因为它意味着压缩现有 LVLM 并不一定需要重新拿到全量训练语料做高成本恢复。

由于给定全文片段没有完整表格数字，这里不硬填具体百分点。但从作者总结可明确把握三点：widthwise 在多数设定下更优；SFT+hidden-state distillation 是最佳恢复组合；5% 数据即可完成相当有效的 recovery。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇更像一篇系统实验手册，适合带着问题读。先看 Introduction 末尾列出的四条发现，再看 Methodology，弄清 layerwise 与 widthwise 的具体实现，以及 recovery 里 SFT、logit KD、hidden-state KD 的组合方式。然后重点看三类结果：一是不同 pruning ratio 下两种剪枝范式的性能曲线；二是 alignment vs language degradation 的分析图；三是 recovery data size 的敏感性实验。

如果你只关心结论，优先看 Fig.1 和主结果表，再看关于 reasoning benchmark 的分解结果，因为那部分最能说明为什么 layerwise 更伤。若你在做多模态模型压缩、蒸馏或边缘部署，建议把 projector-only recovery 与 full-model recovery 的对比也看完。预计 30–45 分钟可以抓住主线；若要复现实验或迁移到自家 LVLM，可能需要连附录中的剪枝细节和训练超参一起读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical alternative to rebuilding compact LVLMs from small language models: structurally pruning an existing LVLM’s language backbone and then recovering performance with lightweight retraining. The core questions are threefold. Which structured pruning paradigm works better for LVLMs—removing layers or shrinking width? After pruning, is the main damage in language capability or in vision-language alignment? And during recovery, which combination of supervised finetuning, logit distillation, hidden-state distillation, and data budget gives the best trade-off?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper in the narrow sense; it is mainly about compression and recovery. Still, it has useful implications for multimodal foundation models. The most valuable part is the diagnosis of where pruning hurts first. The paper argues that under mild compression, multimodal alignment degrades before the language backbone collapses, which means recovery can be targeted rather than fully retrained. That is relevant for multimodal continual pretraining, mid-training compression, distillation, and deployment-oriented model adaptation. The contribution is best viewed as a systematic empirical study rather than a new pruning algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study covers three representative LVLM families: LLaVA-v1.5-7B, Bunny-v1-3B, and Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B. All share the standard decomposition into a vision encoder, a multimodal projector, and a language backbone, so the compression focus is placed on the language model, which dominates parameter count.

Two structured pruning paradigms are compared. The first is layerwise pruning, which removes entire transformer blocks. This follows prior LLM work that treats some layers as redundant. It is simple and hardware-friendly, but it is also coarse and may disrupt the pathways through which multimodal information is integrated at deeper layers. The second is widthwise pruning, which reduces internal width by pruning attention heads and MLP neurons while preserving depth. This is a finer-grained structural change and is hypothesized to preserve multimodal processing better.

After pruning, the authors evaluate several recovery strategies. The base recovery method is supervised finetuning. On top of that, they add knowledge distillation at two levels: output logits and hidden states, with hidden-state distillation implemented via an L2 objective. The paper’s main conclusion is that SFT plus hidden-state distillation is the most reliable combination. That makes sense for LVLMs, where pruning perturbs not only the final token distribution but also the intermediate representation space that supports vision-language alignment.

A particularly useful part of the paper is the degradation analysis. The authors separate performance loss into multimodal alignment degradation and language capability degradation. Their claim is that at low compression ratios, the main issue is alignment damage, so projector-only recovery can already help a lot. At higher compression ratios, both alignment and language capability degrade, so broader recovery becomes necessary. The paper also studies data efficiency by varying both calibration data size and recovery-training data size, addressing the practical question of whether one needs access to the full original multimodal corpus for effective recovery.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the experimental story is clear even if not every table value is visible.

First, the evaluation spans three LVLM families—LLaVA-v1.5-7B, Bunny-v1-3B, and Mini-InternVL-Chat-4B—and includes not only standard multimodal benchmarks but also more reasoning-heavy ones such as AI2D, MathVista, and DocVQA. This matters because pruning often hurts structured reasoning before it hurts simple perception.

Second, the main pruning comparison shows that widthwise pruning consistently outperforms layerwise pruning in low-resource recovery settings. The paper emphasizes that the gap is especially visible on reasoning-oriented benchmarks. The interpretation is that removing whole layers damages deep reasoning paths and cross-modal integration more severely than shrinking width while preserving depth.

Third, the degradation-dynamics analysis is one of the most informative parts. At mild compression levels, the dominant failure mode is multimodal alignment degradation rather than a full collapse of the language backbone. At higher compression levels, both alignment and language capability deteriorate. This directly motivates different recovery strategies: projector-only finetuning can be sufficient under mild pruning, but more aggressive pruning requires broader recovery of the language backbone as well.

Fourth, among recovery methods, SFT combined with hidden-state distillation gives the best and most consistent recovery, outperforming plain SFT and SFT with only logit distillation. This result is plausible because hidden-state matching can restore internal representation geometry and cross-modal alignment more directly than output-level supervision alone.

Fifth, the data-efficiency study yields a practical result: calibration is highly data-efficient, and recovery training remains effective with as little as 5% of the original training data. That makes the pruning-and-recover route much more attractive for deployment scenarios where full retraining is too expensive.

The visible text does not include all exact benchmark numbers, so it would be misleading to invent deltas. But the qualitative findings are clear and central: widthwise pruning is generally the better structural choice, SFT plus hidden-state distillation is the strongest recovery recipe, and useful recovery is possible with a surprisingly small data budget.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as a systems paper rather than a single-method paper. Start with the end of the Introduction, where the authors summarize the four main findings. Then go to the Methodology section to understand exactly how layerwise and widthwise pruning are instantiated and how SFT, logit KD, and hidden-state KD are combined.

For the results, focus on three parts. First, the performance curves across pruning ratios for the two pruning paradigms. Second, the analysis that separates alignment degradation from language degradation; that is where the paper becomes more than a benchmark table. Third, the sensitivity study on recovery data size, which is the most deployment-relevant section. If you only want the main conclusions, start with Fig. 1 and the main result tables, then read the breakdown on reasoning-heavy benchmarks because that section best explains why layerwise pruning is more damaging. Expect about 30–45 minutes for a solid skim; more if you want to reproduce the setup or transfer the recipe to another LVLM.

recommendation.zh: 对 VLM 剪枝的系统性实证研究，结论是 widthwise 剪枝在 low-data regime 下优于 layerwise，对做模型压缩的同学有参考价值。
recommendation.en: A systematic empirical study on VLM pruning, concluding that widthwise pruning outperforms layerwise in low-data regimes; valuable reference for model compression practitioners.

paper.abstract: Despite impressive progress in capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs), these systems remain vulnerable to hallucinations, i.e., outputs that are not grounded in the visual input. Prior work has attributed hallucinations in LVLMs to factors such as limitations of the vision backbone or the dominance of the language component, yet the relative importance of these factors remains unclear. To resolve this ambiguity, We propose HalluScope, a benchmark to better understand the extent to

summary.core_problem: 在现代 LVLM 中，视觉幻觉到底主要来自哪里：视觉感知失败、语义共现先验（language prior），还是指令文本里“预设”(presupposition) 强行带入的事实？论文要把这三类来源拆开测清楚，并给出一个专门针对“指令预设诱导幻觉”的可操作缓解方案。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练研究的直接价值不在“又一个幻觉 benchmark”，而在于把幻觉来源从“感知 vs 语言”进一步细分到“指令预设”这一更贴近对齐/后训练信号的问题：当视觉 backbone 足够强时，错误更多是跨模态对齐与指令遵循机制的副作用。对做 VLM 预训练/中后期训练的人，这提供了两个可落地的抓手：
1) 评测侧：用可控问题族把 hallucination 归因到不同机制，而不是用单一分数混在一起；
2) 训练侧：用偏好优化把模型从“顺着问题编”拉回到“先验证图像再回答”，本质是改写 instruction-following 的优先级。
summary.technical_approach:
1) HalluScope 诊断集设计：围绕同一批图像构造不同“诱因”的问题族，分别测：
- Positive Object Recognition：问图中确实存在的物体，测基本感知/识别是否可靠。
- Random Object Recognition：问与场景无关且不存在的随机物体，测无根据的“乱答 yes”。
- Adversarial Object Recognition：问语义上很合理、与场景共现概率高但实际不存在的物体（例如桌子旁的椅子），用来量化模型对共现先验的依赖。
- Adversarial Presupposition Attribute：更进一步，把“物体存在”作为问题预设，再问属性（颜色/材质等），例如“椅子是什么颜色？”在图里没有椅子时会诱导模型编造一个椅子并给出颜色；这一组专门测 instruction presupposition 的支配力。
数据构造上，作者先从 COCO 里用 caption embedding + k-center greedy 选语义覆盖更广的子集，减少评测被少数场景分布主导。

2) 结论性发现（机制层面）：在不少现代 LVLM 上，感知题（Positive/Random）表现并不差，但在“共现诱导”与尤其“预设诱导”题上错误显著增多，说明主要问题不是看不见，而是语言侧（指令与先验）在冲突时压过了视觉证据。

3) HalluVL-DPO 缓解：用偏好优化（DPO 类）做定向微调，目标是让“ grounded answer（承认看不到/否认预设）”在偏好上压过“顺着预设编造的回答”。关键点是 sample-informativeness：不是均匀用所有偏好对，而是更强调那些更能暴露预设诱导幻觉、梯度更有效的样本（论文表述为基于信息量的变体）。训练数据来自大规模生成的偏好对，偏好准则围绕“是否基于图像证据、是否拒绝不成立的预设”。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的核心实验结构是：
- 诊断：在 HalluScope 四类问题上对多种 LVLM 做分项评测，展示“预设诱导”子集最能拉开差距，并且与纯感知错误弱相关，从而支持归因。
- 缓解：用 HalluVL-DPO 微调后，在 HalluScope 的目标子集（尤其 Adversarial Presupposition Attribute）幻觉显著下降；同时在通用多模态能力上尽量保持（作者声称“maintain strong general multimodal performance”）。
- 泛化：在既有 hallucination benchmark（文中点名 POPE/CHAIR/SHR/MMHAL-Bench 等）上也有一致改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a precise attribution question for LVLM hallucinations: when a model produces ungrounded outputs, how much is due to (i) visual perception failures, (ii) learned semantic/co-occurrence priors, or (iii) presuppositions injected by the instruction itself? It then targets the instruction-presupposition failure mode with a preference-optimization fine-tuning recipe.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution for foundation-model researchers is the reframing: as vision backbones get stronger, a large fraction of hallucinations look less like perception errors and more like a modality-alignment / instruction-following priority issue. HalluScope operationalizes this by separating co-occurrence bias from instruction presupposition, which is often conflated in prior benchmarks. On the mitigation side, the work is a concrete example of using preference optimization to reweight the model’s internal trade-off between “comply with the question” and “verify against visual evidence,” which is directly relevant to post-training signals that feed back into pretraining objectives and data design.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) HalluScope benchmark: for each image, construct controlled question families to isolate different causes.
- Positive Object Recognition: query objects truly present (checks basic visual recognition).
- Random Object Recognition: query unrelated absent objects (checks spurious ‘yes’ behavior).
- Adversarial Object Recognition: query plausible-but-absent objects that commonly co-occur with the scene (measures reliance on semantic priors over pixels).
- Adversarial Presupposition Attribute: ask for an attribute of an adversarial object while presupposing its existence (e.g., “What color is the chair?” when no chair exists), explicitly probing instruction-induced presupposition.
The image pool is selected from COCO with caption-embedding diversity (k-center greedy) to avoid narrow scene bias.

2) Diagnosis claim: many LVLMs are reasonably accurate on perception checks yet fail heavily on adversarial/presupposition subsets, indicating that language-side priors and instruction presuppositions can override visual evidence.

3) HalluVL-DPO: a DPO-style preference optimization fine-tuning that prefers grounded responses (deny/abstain when the presupposition is false) over hallucinated compliance. A key tweak is sample informativeness weighting—training emphasizes preference pairs that are more diagnostic/effective for correcting presupposition-driven hallucinations. The preference dataset is large-scale and generated to stress these failure cases.
summary_en.experiments:
The experimental narrative has two pillars:
- Factorized evaluation: report per-subset performance on HalluScope across multiple LVLMs, showing the presupposition subset as the dominant failure mode and weakly correlated with pure perception errors.
- Targeted mitigation: HalluVL-DPO reduces hallucinations on the presupposition-driven subset and yields consistent gains on established hallucination benchmarks (e.g., POPE/CHAIR/SHR/MMHAL-Bench), while aiming to preserve general multimodal capability.
